jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Help Build the Future of Autonomous Supply Chain Management
At
Burnt
, we’re building an AI-native operating system for the food supply chain—replacing legacy ERPs with intelligent agents that automate 80% of the work across sales, operations, credit control, and even ERP implementation. Distributors today are drowning in fragmented data, buried in email and WhatsApp orders, and losing millions to bad debt, frozen inventory, and failed SAP projects. Our agents automate order capture, follow up on overdue invoices, resolve SKU mismatches, and can even compress ERP go-lives from 2 years to 2 months. One of the hardest technical challenges we’re solving is the lack of unified context—food distributors' data is spread across disconnected systems, APIs, PDFs, and spreadsheets. We're building a "truth store" for each enterprise and a swarm of memory-augmented agents to act on it. As a
founding engineer
, you’ll work across LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent planning, and real-time decision systems—powering the backend of a vertically integrated AI company that deeply understands supply chain workflows. Our stack includes Python, Java (Spring Boot), AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, RDS), Pinecone, and foundation models from OpenAI and Bedrock. If you’re excited to own architectural decisions, ship real-world AI products, and build systems that can change how the $10T+ supply chain industry operates, we’d love to talk.
About the interview
Initial conversation with CEO (30 mins)
Cultural round with CPO
2 hour tech Interview / white boarding session with CTO
2-14 day paid work trial
Final team conversation (45 mins)
Aboutburnt
Burnt’s building an agentic OS for the Food Supply Chain with AI Agents for each department. Our first AI Agent replaces the whole order management team at food distribution companies that sell into restaurants.
Our agent monitors all incoming messages, figures out if it's an order, learns each customer's habits, shorthand, and favorite products, picks up on any prep notes, and enters it straight into the existing ERP. The more it sees, the smarter it gets.

jobs.title: Senior Chemical Research Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About Duranium
We’re working to produce the most profitable light-weight metals in the world, here in the US, and carbon neutrally. We’re doing this by leveraging existing chlorination and electrolytic technology, while designing a novel molten materials process that takes byproducts from the metal production process and creates critical feedstock and high value coproducts. We are located in Alameda and are building our pilot plant for operation in the Bay Area Q2 2026.
What’s in it for you?
You’ll be working with a team of smart, creative people who are looking to disrupt legacy producers and change how the US thinks about material production. You will have the opportunity to make an immediate impact on day one. This is a pivotal role within our team, where you will play a crucial part in advancing our first-of-its-kind technology to the next stage. If you are driven by innovation and eager to contribute to the development of cutting-edge solutions, we encourage you to connect with us.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced chemical engineer with specialized expertise in hazardous gas handling systems to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing chemical processes for our advanced metal refinement operations, with a particular focus on systems
involving corrosive gases. You will work cross-functionally alongside our CTO to design experiments, analyze data, and improve performance. In the near term you will be working on the design and delivery of the pilot plant.
Key Responsibilities
Design and optimize chemical processes for metal refinement operations including the involvement of hazardous gases at the pilot scale
Develop and implement safety protocols and risk management procedures
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate gas handling systems with overall plant operations
Perform hazard analysis (HAZOP, FMEA) and develop mitigation strategies
Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other regulatory requirements for hazardous materials
Lead troubleshooting efforts for process optimization and equipment performance
Prepare technical documentation, reports, and standard operating procedures
Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance
Support pilot plant operations and scale-up activities
Required Skills
Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related field
4-10 years of hands-on experience in chemical process engineering (can include internships and research)
Experience with hazardous gas handling equipment, scrubber systems, and emergency response protocols
Proficiency in process simulation software
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of metallurgical processes and metal refinement operations
Background in process control systems and automation
Knowledge of environmental regulations and permitting processes
Experience with lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
Previous work in mining, metallurgy, or specialty chemicals industries
Compensation
Salary range: $120,000 - $160,000 annually (commensurate with experience)
Highly competitive stock package
Health, Dental and Eye insurance
If you're driven to create groundbreaking technology and want to be part of something truly transformative, this is your chance. Join us early and grow with enormous upside potential!
AboutDuranium
We’re working to produce the most profitable light-weight metals in the world, here in the US, and carbon neutrally. We’re doing this by leveraging existing chlorination and electrolytic technology, while designing a novel molten materials process that takes byproducts from the metal production process and creates critical feedstock and high value coproducts. We are located in Alameda and are building our pilot plant for operation in the Bay Area Q2 2026.

jobs.description:
About the role
Company
Hey 👋, we’re Haz and Wyatt, the founders of Pally, and we’re building at the
intersection of AI and human relationships.
We believe that while AI will automate a lot of low-level tasks, that this will
dramatically increase the value of human connection at the highest level.
In a world full of ‘AI SDRs’, our warm connections become more important than ever.
Yet today, keeping track of thousands of connections across countless social platforms is impossible. We forget to respond, we miss important moments, we lose touch.
We’re building Pally to solve that.
We bring together every connection, across every platform. Our AI researches everything they’ve ever posted online, and uses its deep understanding of each person to help you achieve your goals; whether hiring, fundraising, or sales.
We’re backed by YC (S25), cofounders from Hugging Face and Slack, the Head of Sales at Superhuman, Craft Ventures Scout Fund, a16z Scout Fund, and Founders Inc.
Role
Following our pre-seed round, and getting accepted into YC S25, we’re hiring for our first engineers: a founding backend engineer, and a founding design engineer.
Your role as our founding engineer (backend) will be to work on our backend systems, cloud architecture, AI models, and agentic workflows.
The role will span beyond the traditional bounds of engineering… As an early hire you will be expected to take shared overall ownership of the product, speak to users, and ensure an incredible user experience. We’re in this together; we win as a team and lose as a team.
Tech Stack
Our backend is all written in python, with FastAPI, hosted on Supabase, AWS ECS, and Lambda functions. We use a variety of models for different use cases, but predominantly OpenAI.
Profile
You could be the right fit if you’re a product-minded engineer with founding/startup experience, and have a deep understanding of large language models (inc. training, fine-tuning, deployment), machine learning, backend architecture and cloud infrastructure.
We don’t care about traditional ‘credentials’, we care about grit. You will be an outlier with a demonstrated track record of achieving greatness and overcoming exceptionally hard problems.
As for values: you believe relationships are everything. You care about the people you work with. You give more than you take. You take artistic pride in everything you do. You know that
‘good enough’
is not good enough.
Practical Stuff
In-person, in San Francisco, starting ASAP.
We work exceptionally hard. You should expect a minimum of 60-80 hours per week. If work isn’t your primary focus, this isn’t for you. You need to be all-in.
However, we stand by our belief that
relationships are everything
. That means your family and friends as well. You will be there for your family and friends when they need you, and you will find time to achieve your work goals around that. We don’t care when you work exceptionally hard, only that you do. Your schedule is up to you.
If you’re interested in applying to this role, please apply today.
Thank you for taking the time to consider joining us,
Haz + Wyatt

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior AI Engineer to own our AI’s ability to understand, respond to, and act on user queries from the ground up. This is not a research role or a “prompt tinkering” side project. You will build agentic LLM systems that can connect to external tools and APIs, structure their reasoning, and execute actions reliably.
You’ll be hands-on with prompt engineering, LLM frameworks, and agent design, while also applying software engineering rigor to make these systems stable, scalable, and useful. The right candidate moves fast, learns new methods as the field shifts, and always drives toward business outcomes, not demos or academic novelty.
We don’t believe in overwork or equating hours with outcomes. What matters is results tied to business and customer outcomes—nothing else.
This is a hybrid role, 3–4 days per week in-office in Mission Viejo.
What You’ll Do
Design and implement LLM-powered agents that can reason, decide, and act via connected APIs, databases, and external systems.
Own the prompting, fine-tuning, and orchestration that make these systems intelligent and usable.
Apply strong engineering principles (modularity, testing, observability) so the AI’s actions are reliable in production.
Continuously scan the landscape for new frameworks, libraries, and techniques, and integrate what’s useful.
Collaborate with product and leadership to ensure progress is tied directly to business results.
Document decisions and trade-offs, ensuring clarity for current and future teammates.
Proven ability to deliver usable systems under startup constraints: full ownership of outcomes, small teams, fast pivots, and delivering usable systems with limited resources.
Work in a modified agile framework based on your direct input (no dogma or purist approach) with daily standups and project management coordinated between you, the COO, and two other engineers (frontend and backend).
Take strategic and product guidance from a cofounder who will be in-office with you in Orange County. The COO supports your growth and ensures you have what you need to succeed, while the cofounders focus on product excellence
You'll occasionally join customer calls to hear feedback and problems directly from users.
Must-Haves
Strong, validated expertise in software engineering with expertise shipping production systems from beginning to end.
Deep hands-on work with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source stacks, LangChain/LlamaIndex/transformers, etc.) and expertise in building agents using them.
Experience building multi-step, tool-using agents that act across varied systems, not just single-action chatbots
Proven ability to pick up new technologies quickly and apply them pragmatically.
Ability to turn messy, ambiguous problems into solvable projects, with clear scoping, regular updates, and visible progress for stakeholders
Excellent communication: clearly defines projects, can explain assumptions, trade-offs, and progress clearly.
What We Value
We hire for mental models, not buzzwords. The right candidate will embody:
Bias to Progress
→ Keeps work moving, persistent in ambiguity, avoids getting stuck.
Business Results First
→ Prioritizes impact over complexity, identity, or “cool tech.”
Simplicity Bias
→ Builds the leanest path to the outcome, avoids overbuilding.
Ownership
→ Takes responsibility, integrates feedback, doesn’t deflect blame.
Adaptability
→ Learns new tools fast, evolves methods as the field shifts.
Collaborative Pragmatism
→ Can disagree respectfully, align quickly, and execute.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or vector DBs.
Exposure to evaluation frameworks for LLMs to ensure reliability scoring and reduce hallucinations.
Experience in startups or lean environments where speed and iteration matter.
Compensation and Growth
$150,000 + Equity
Health, Dental and Vision Insurance + Dependents
Four Weeks Paid Time Off (We try to encourage you to take time off)
About the interview
At Humoniq, we design hiring to be fair, predictive, and respectful of your time. You’ll have the chance to show what you can do on your own terms, choosing when and where, so you’re able to perform at your best.
The data is clear:
resumes are one of the weakest predictors of job performance
(Hunter & Schmidt’s meta-analysis, ~0.1–0.2 correlation). They’re noisy, biased toward pedigree, and reward formatting skills.
That’s why we combine structured interviews with research-backed assessments.
Fairness:
Interviews can sometimes reward confidence over skill. Assessments give every candidate the same chance to show their abilities, leveling the playing field.
Effectiveness:
Decades of studies show assessments are stronger predictors of job success than interviews alone. They help us focus on real skills, not just first impressions.
For You:
This means you won’t be judged on resume, background, accent, or personality quirks, but on what really matters is your ability to do the work.
Our entire process will take less than 8 hours, and will not require any ‘at home’ assessment from you. There will be an in person component as part of the last interview.
AboutHumoniq

jobs.description:
About the role
About Truth Systems
At
Truth Systems
, we’re building the only trust and safety software any organization will ever need. A protection layer for every individual.
To do so, we’ve designed real-time governance and compliance agents. These agents validate every action someone takes in their desktop environment against a set of rules and protect people from mistakes.
We are:
Small and well-funded
. We’ve raised $4M from world-class investors.
We are currently a team of 4
. We are hiring thoughtfully, with ~3 people in the next 6 months.
Intensely trustful + high ownership.
We optimize for impact per person by requiring high ownership from each member of our team. We hire experts, ambitious problem solvers, generally unstoppable people and we place large amounts of trust in them. We prefer short (or no) meetings, full autonomy, and individualized schedules.
Your Mission
Over the next 12-18 months, you will be one of our core product builders. This means you will talk to clients, scope and design features, and implement from scratch.
Outcomes
0 → 1 roadmap delivery.
You’ll need to own a section of our roadmap and ship them from 0 → 1. This includes the full cycle, from idea/client discovery to rollout. Feature outcomes are measured via adoption and direct client feedback.
Reliable, secure, accurate, and fast engineering.
With the stakes that we’re working with, we need to get things correct. We’re building always-on software (e.g, 99.5% crash-free and secure-by-default). Our agents must be accurate (e.g, one of our features has 0.9 F1) and can’t add significant latency (e.g, another feature has <0.3s p95 inference time requirements).
Competencies
Taste and product building experience (must have).
You have to love building ‘tasteful’ products that customers love using. This typically means 0 → 1 experience alongside strong frontend/design/UI/UX understanding.
React + backend + engineering hygiene (must have).
Strong TypeScript/React; hands-on backend experience (Node, Go, or Python). Good engineering hygiene (CI/CD, tests, reviews).
Deeply empathetic (must be).
Both our team and our customers require empathetic and low-ego people. Some of our users’ careers depend on our product being ‘right’, so trusting and listening to them is our most important skill.
Independent and process building (must be).
We don’t have a lot of structure. You’ll build a lot of processes and make standards by yourself, and everybody we hire after you will follow these.
Endpoint/inference experience (nice to have) :
Experience with browser extensions/device endpoints, and very fast/scalable inference would be useful for this role.
Logistics
Salary
: 120-200k
Equity: 0.3-1%
Location:
In-person in SF, and (optionally) occasional travel either for clients or for offsite.
Perks:
Meals, housing/relocation, equipment, and benefits provided.

We can’t sponsor visas at this time.

We’re at the bleeding edge of technology. There will not be tidy tutorials for you to follow. You should be exceptional at reading documentation and raw source code on GitHub.
Can you move fast?
We’re hiring rapid prototypers. You should be inclined to ship rough prototypes fast, and then iterate them to perfection throughout the summer.
Are you comfortable working across the entire tech stack?
We’re a lean team with a lot to be built. As an example, you should be comfortable writing FastAPIs one day, taking ownership of a Next.js frontend feature the next day, all while managing server load balancing, auto scaling, and telemetry.
Do you want to change the world?
We’re looking for a mission-driven engineer who’s passionate about writing high-quality code with an insatiable desire to mold the world through AI. We want to change the way AI agents are used and deployed, with a view of becoming a fully-fledged AI research lab specialized in the mid- and post-training of LLM agents.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
About the interview
Applying.
If this opportunity sounds interesting, please contact
win@dedaluslabs.ai
to express your interest and qualifications (e.g. résumé) for the role. Applications are considered on a
rolling basis
, so we encourage you to apply early!
Callback.
Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot respond to everyone. If there is mutual interest, we will get back to you in 1-2 days to schedule a phone interview.
Interview.
The interview will be a 30-45min Zoom call consisting of:
Behavioral (10-15min)
Live coding challenge (20-30min)
To simulate a real working environment, you can access
anything
on the internet during the coding portion. We are interested in seeing what your full workflow looks like.
You will hear back the same day or the following day.
Offer.
If we proceed with you as our summer intern, we will formally send out an onboarding email, invite you to the company Slack, and book your plane tickets to SF!
The deadline to apply is June 4th at 11:59 PM AoE.
We look forward to hearing from you!
AboutDedalus Labs
Dedalus Labs is building the MCP gateway for the next generation of AI applications by unifying the fragmented AI agents ecosystem with a single drop-in API endpoint. We host and manage your MCP servers, allowing users to go from idea to production in a single click. Users can pick any model from any vendor, mix-and-match whatever tools they want from our MCP marketplace, and ship within minutes.

jobs.description:
About the role
At Godela, we're building the first Physics Foundation Model; a physics-informed AI platform learns from simulation, experiment, and equations to instantly predict and simulate physical behavior.
At Godela, our vision is to push the boundaries of scientific discovery and engineering innovation. We’re scaling deep-learning surrogates so every engineer has the power of an R&D lab at their fingertips to turn months of simulation and experimentation into minutes.
Founding Simulation Engineer
We are seeking a
Founding Simulation & Data Engineer
to help us build and scale the world's first Physics Foundation Model. This role is a strategic pillar, focusing on
defining the data engine and validation strategy
required to ensure our models accurately capture the complex physical world.

Define the methodology for representing physical systems in data and models—balancing accuracy, scale, and generalization.

Solver development experience

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
jobs.description:
About the role
We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Full-Stack) to join our team in the San Francisco Bay Area. We're focused on solving a big problem: how to make all the annoying tasks outside of your code editor fully agentic; everything from deployment to performance, incidents, and bugs.
You'll be working directly with me (
Daniel
). Before StarSling, I was the Engineering Manager at Netflix working on the most used internal tool for their 3K+ engineers and tens of thousands of microservices — an internal developer portal called Netflix Console. Earlier in my career I was an engineer on Facebook’s AI Camera team and helped build the mobile computer vision library that currently powers camera effects for 100M+ DAUs across IG, FB, and WhatsApp. I’m obsessed with helping every engineer be more productive.
You’ll also be working directly with my co-founder
Yonas
. Before StarSling, Yonas was the Founder & CEO of StackShare, a developer community used by over 40 million developers. He raised $12M as a first-time founder and did founder sales to get them to just under $1M ARR with their enterprise product before selling the company last year. He’s obsessed with creating product experiences that developers love and building community.
💻 What You’ll Own
Event-driven backend:
Architect our Node.js / Next.js / TypeScript and Supabase stack. Design schemas, event flows and ingest dev tools webhooks to power a real-time personalized engineering portal.
LLM Agentic Workflows:
Build a
system of agents
— MCP, tool use, memory, retry logic, context updates, feedback mechanisms.
Agent Experience (AX):
Create intuitive product interfaces for human-agent interactions. Explore and iterate with engineers to find the right interaction paradigm to productivity work with a digital co-pilot.
System Design & Technical Strategy:
Work directly with me to determine the best technical path that balances moving fast and scaling to many customers using different dev tools. Determine how we integrate and support the open-source community.
✅ This IS for you if
You’re a full-stack 0-to-1 builder
who has shipped to production. Especially in rapidly shipping NextJS apps and working with event-based systems in a serverless architecture.
You have a genuine curiosity about agentic product experiences
and are excited about understanding the impact of AI on engineering users.
You’re a previous founder or founding engineer.
You have built something from scratch that people use or pay for.
You’re unusually obsessed with hard problems.
Your current skills or even what you've done before is less important than your ability to go all-in and accomplish anything that you set your mind to.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity
and adapting to dynamic priorities. You need to have good judgement to know when to let little fires burn and when to immediately jump in.
You have excellent communication and candor.
You’ll be communicating directly with engineers and collaborating with us on key decisions.
You care about helping swamped engineers
fight through the
schlep
of software development. If that's not an exciting mission for you, it will be hard to stay motivated through the inevitable highs and lows.
You have grit and perseverance.
You should accustomed to picking between hard options and pushing through it.
❌ This IS NOT for you if
You’re not based in The Bay Area
(we’ll be a team of four if you join so we’ll be sitting next to each other everyday)
You’re not willing to work six days per week
(we take Sundays off)
You’re not excited about using codegen tools
like Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, etc.
You’re not comfortable deleting
80%-90% of the code that you write.
You’re not comfortable with ambiguity
and rapid context-switching.
You don’t like candor
- receiving and giving direct, honest feedback.
You need a well defined structure
or career ladder.
🌍 The Opportunity
Work alongside two experienced co-founders
- one who built and sold a dev tools startup and one who led the engineering effort to create the same product we’re creating at scale
Get experience across the startup stack
- you’ll be doing customer support, bug squashing, user interviews, events, and everything else along with writing code
Be one of the first employees of the next dev tools category leader
- we’re not just building a dev tool, we’re building an engineering platform that every company in Silicon Valley will be using and paying for
AboutStarSling
StarSling is an agentic internal developer portal (IDP) that houses all your internal services, applications, APIs, documentation and has AI agents continuously improving them for you. One interface that automates all the tasks that eat up a developer’s time after they’ve left their code editor: deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs.

Type:
Full-time Remote (US-first)

only if we put safety first

founding operations
role. You won’t “run a process”—you’ll
design the process, the playbooks, and the bar

recruit and train annotator bench globally

AI coding tools
(Copilot/Cursor/Codex) and lightweight
Python/SQL
to automate processes, analyze variance/drift, and accelerate delivery. You’ll partner with customers to
define and refine annotation requirements
, and with Product/Eng to shape UX, guardrails, and platform roadmap.
What You’ll Do
Own customer programs end-to-end:
translate goals into schemas, rubrics, gold sets, and success metrics; pilot → scale with clear reporting and write-ups.
Define & refine requirements with customers:
run scoping sessions, lock criteria/edge-case taxonomies/IAA targets; iterate as models and prompts change.
Recruit, onboard, and train annotators:
source SMEs, design paid trials, build training artifacts, calibrate on gold data, and manage QA/arb loops.
Ship with AI-accelerated ops:
write quick scripts and notebooks for data transforms, audits, log parsing, schema reconciliation, and quality analytics.
Build the operating system:
SLAs, sampling plans, consensus/appeals, audit trails, and continuous calibration; make quality measurable and repeatable.
Close the loop:
drive prompt/model/policy experiments; surface insights to Product/Eng; propose UI tweaks and guardrails that raise signal-to-noise.
What Will Make You Successful
Company-builder mindset:
you’ve built 0→1 programs or teams, created playbooks, and raised the bar for quality and speed.
Customer-facing clarity:
you convert open-ended asks into precise pass/fail criteria and aren’t afraid to propose a better spec.
People leadership:
you attract, calibrate, and motivate high-judgment annotators while holding a crisp, documented bar.
Hands-on with data & AI tools:
comfortable with AI coding assistants plus
basic Python/SQL
to answer questions fast and automate the dull bits.
Execution bias:
you prefer small pilots and rapid iteration over lengthy specs, and you over-communicate risks and status.
Qualifications
2–4+ years in data/product/research operations for ML/AI, relevance, or safety—or equivalent “high-judgment at scale” experience.
Track record
recruiting, onboarding, and training
annotators/raters with gold-set calibration and QA loops.
Demonstrated
program ownership
: requirements, change management, stakeholder updates, and postmortems.
Excellent writing: rubrics, edge-case guides, SOPs, and crisp weekly reports.
Nice to Have
Trust & Safety, RLHF/RLAIF, search/relevance, or regulated domains (medical, legal, finance).
Experience designing evaluator UIs, prompt templates, or judgment tasks for LLMs/multimodal models.
Familiarity with IAA stats, sampling methods, or experiment design.
Compensation & Ownership
Founding-level role with meaningful equity and scope to
define what it means to build an AI-first data annotation company
—from playbooks and metrics to culture and hiring.
AboutBesimple AI
Why Us
At
Besimple AI
, we’re making it radically easier for teams to
build and ship reliable AI
by fixing the hardest part of the stack:
data
.  Good evaluation, training and safety data require domain experts, robust tooling and meticulous QA.  AI teams and labs come to us to get high quality data so they can launch AI safely.  We’re a
YC X25
company based in
Redwood City, CA
, already powering evaluation and training pipelines for leading AI companies across
customer support, search, and education
. Join now to be close to
real customer impact
, not just demos.
Why This Matters
High-quality, human-reviewed data is still the
single biggest driver of model quality
, but most teams are stuck with old tools and legacy processes that do not scale to
modern, multimodal, agentic workflows
. Besimple replaces that mess with
instant custom UIs, tailored rubrics, and an end-to-end human-in-the-loop workflow
that supports
text, chat, audio, video, LLM traces, and more
. We meet teams where they are—whether they need
on-prem deployments and granular user management
or a fast cloud setup—to turn
evaluation into a continuous capability
rather than a one-time project.
Traction & Customers
Who You’ll Work With
Founders previously
built the annotation platform that supported Meta’s Llama models
. We’ve seen how world-class annotation systems shape
model quality and iteration speed
; we’re bringing those lessons to every AI team that needs to ship with confidence. You’ll work directly with the founders and users, owning problems end-to-end—from an interface that
unlocks a tough rubric
, to a workflow that
reduces disagreement
, to a
AI judge system
that improves quality.
How We Work
Bias to shipping
and learning with customers
Respect for craft
: calibration, rubric clarity, inter-annotator agreement (IRR)
Tight feedback loops
from production back to evaluation
Ownership
: you’ll shape
evaluation as an engineering discipline
with real
“fail-to-ship” tests
tied to business and safety goals
If you’re excited by systems that combine
product design, human judgment, and applied AI
—and you want to build the
data and evaluation layer
that keeps AI trustworthy—come build with us. See how fast teams can go from
raw logs
to a
robust, human-in-the-loop eval pipeline
—and how that changes the way they ship AI.

We’re a tiny group of engineers on a mission to democratize high‑quality authentication and make auth something every developer can truly own.
Our open‑source framework is already one of the fastest‑growing auth solutions in the world. It’s trusted by thousands of developers and is rapidly adopted by startups and YC companies alike.

TechCrunch

Better Auth, an authentication tool by a self-taught Ethiopian dev, raises $5M from Peak XV, YC

the most upvoted YC Launch in YC’s history
:
Better Auth on YC Launch
.

Collaborating across backend, frontend, and design to ship features that make developers’ lives easier
Building at the edge between frontend and backend with TypeScript, React, and Node
Owning features end‑to‑end, from concept to production deployment
Managing and improving our plugin ecosystem for developers
Mentoring junior developers and contributing to planning and review sessions

You’ll enjoy high ownership and join a team that’s still early but already making a huge impact. You’ll work deeply on developer experience and thrive in a collaborative, low‑ego environment.
This is a very early team. You’re not joining an existing culture - you’ll be helping define it. We value agentic people who take initiative, push ideas forward, and shape the future rather than wait for direction.
We carve out plenty of time for heads‑down building while tackling meaningful problems. We value strong opinions, open discussion, and the humility to change direction when needed.
We focus on the sweet spot between what excites you and what moves the company forward. Here, you’ll own projects, ship features, and grow quickly alongside a team that’s redefining what authentication can be.
Required Skills:
5+ years of software development experience
Strong TypeScript expertise (bonus points if you’ve wrestled with complex generics)
Familiarity with different auth‑related specs and concepts
Experience taking features from 0→1—shipping is second nature to you
Bonus Points:
Experience maintaining open‑source projects
Experience architecting or building complex auth systems
Company benefits:
Compensation: $140k–$180k USD based on experience (with very generous equity)
Fully remote:
anywhere in the world (preference for USA or nearby time zones)
Early‑stage ownership
in a high‑growth company
AboutBetter Auth
Better Auth is a comprehensive authentication framework for TypeScript that lets you implement everything from simple auth flows to enterprise-grade systems directly on your own database, embedded in your backend. It’s loved by developers all over the world and endorsed by leading voices in the ecosystem.
On top of the framework, Better Auth also provides an infrastructure layer to help you scale with user management and analytics, bot and fraud detection, transactional email and SMS, global session storage and more.

About the role
Attune
is building developer tools for a post-AI world.
Our first product is faster build tools that require zero migration effort. AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever. The next bottleneck will be all the other tooling between code and deployment.
We’re looking for a Founding Software Engineer to help us build the future of software development: someone with the taste to see how the future of software development should look, and the autonomy and pragmatism to build that future.
This is for you if
You care deeply about the craft of software engineering.
We think the best tools can only be built by people who earnestly care.

We’ll mostly be building in Rust, but you should expect to quickly pick up other languages in order to understand how their build systems work.

Hacking compilers tends to involve a lot of reading the spec, realizing that the spec is incomplete, and then reading the source code to understand behavior.
You own problems end-to-end.
Building the future involves talking to customers, understanding their needs, navigating ambiguity, and wearing lots of hats. Bonus points if you’ve shipped 0-to-1 in production before.
Why you should join
Work alongside experienced co-founders.
Both of us have scaled previous developer tools companies from zero to 8 figures, and we know where all the pitfalls are.
Build the future you want to see.
Have you ever been annoyed at your tools, but never had time to actually fix them? Come work on that full-time.
Fix a huge problem.
Software teams spend over $4B a year on builds alone, and that’s just where we’re starting.
AboutAttune
Attune is building developer tools for a post-AI world.
Our first product is faster build tools that require zero migration effort. AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever. The next bottleneck will be all the other tooling between code and deployment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Company Overview
GroundControl
is a technology company revolutionizing quality for aerospace and defense manufacturers. Our mission is to deliver advanced software solutions that enable manufacturers to produce high-quality parts and systems with precision and confidence. These parts power the most advanced aerospace and defense systems in North America today, from rockets and commercial airliners, to advanced next-gen fighter jets. GroundControl is a seed stage YCombinator company, with investors including 8VC, hyper-strategic family office, and notable angel investors.
Our software streamlines First Article Inspection (FAI) reporting, ensures compliance with AS9102 standards, and reduces the risk of errors and delays. By integrating powerful data processing capabilities with an intuitive user interface, we help manufacturers optimize their quality management processes.
This position is intended to be on-site working with local and remote counter parts. However for the right candidate we will consider remote or hybrid work.
What you’ll do
As the early hire at GroundControl, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the product and engineering culture for the future of the company. You will work directly with the founding team across engineering, product, and customer success. You will:
Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers
Contribute to our Next.js Application and Python/Golang severless functions to improve reliability and progress the product roadmap
Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next-steps
Interface directly with end-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints
Who You Are
CORE REQUIREMENTS
Strong software engineering background (5+ years) from industry
At least 5 years working with Javascript/Typescript, React in production systems
Experience building scalable and responsive web-based user interfaces
Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints to deliver full solutions
Candidates must be Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada and meet all other requirements under Controlled Goods Program (CGP)
DESIRED REQUIREMENTS
Experience working with Python and/or Golang
Experience working with LLMs
Experience working with AWS, in particular GovCloud
Significant experience with writing test suites for React applications (Jest, Playwright)
Deep relational database knowledge (Postgres specifically)
Experience working on enterprise software and the features required by that customer segment
What We Value
Extreme Ownership
You will talk directly with customers from needs, to design, to production code. You will own entire features end-to-end.
Customer Obsession
All decisions should come directly from listening to customers. Understand their needs and pain points, and make decisions that will benefit the end user.
Low Ego, High Impact
We value humility and collaboration over ego. Team members bring strong ideas but are open to feedback and new perspectives, focusing on the best outcomes for the company and our customers. Strong opinions, held loosely
AboutGroundControl
GroundControl is a vertical SaaS company solving hidden inefficiencies in highly-regulated manufacturing. Our first product empowers manufacturers to produce high-quality parts for the most advanced aerospace & defense platforms, from SpaceX rockets and Boeing 777s to next-gen fighter jets and missile systems.
This is not a vision for the future. We are live and operational in manufacturers across the US, automating 1000s of reports and growing rapidly.

jobs.title: Build the SMART GLASSES community - Head of Dev Experience
jobs.description:
About the role
Mentra is building the operating system for smart glasses, and we’re doing things differently. We don’t think there will be an “Apple of smart glasses.” The best future is open, user-empowering, and cross-compatible. Smart glasses literally control what we see and hear, so control must belong only to the person wearing them. That’s why we must succeed.
And for us to succeed, we need developers to succeed. No personal computer has ever won without third-party apps. For smart glasses to be the next personal computer, we need to help the builders build. That’s where this role comes in.
The Role
We’re hiring a
Head of Developer Experience
to make MentraOS the default way to build smart glasses apps. Success looks like this: MentraOS is what people think of when they Google “smart glasses dev,” ChatGPT recommends us, HackerNews loves us, our Discord is teeming.
We have a community of ~5k members in our Discord, hundreds of developers building apps, dozens of companies pre-ordering our hardware for our pilots. We’re on the brink of a personal computing revolution, and we need to help the builders build. You help the builders build and grow the #1 smart glasses dev community in the world.
What you’ll do
Grow and run our developer community (Discord, Reddit, events).
Make the end-to-end developer experience amazing—clear docs, smooth onboarding, great support.
Support developers technically and non-technically (SDK, APIs, B2B partners).
Review and approve apps for our store, give feedback, and help devs ship.
Run hackathons and events to grow mindshare and get hardware in devs’ hands.
Own technical documentation—everyone writes, you ensure it’s excellent.
What we’re looking for
SWE background—comfortable diving into new tech fast.
Experience building and growing developer communities.
Loves devs, loves helping them win.
Wide skillset: technical support, documentation, events, growth.
IRL in San Francisco (we’re here, devs are here, you’ll be here). Travel around the world. Chinese language ability is a huge bonus.
Proactive, high-ownership, crazy passionate about smart glasses/AR.
Apply if you want to own developer success on the next personal computer
AboutMentra
Mentra is building MentraOS, the open-source OS for smart glasses. It's like Android for smart glasses.
Smart glasses hardware is finally ready, and we're building the software ecosystem to unlock the next personal computer.
Our team (ex. MIT, Tsinghua, JITX (YCS18), University of Toronto) has been building smart glasses for over 6 years.
The hardware was never ready, but breakthroughs in micro-optoelectronics has give us lightweight, all-day wearable smart glasses and put us on the precipice of the next personal computing revolution.
But the software still sucks. The apps still suck.
We're building MentraOS to change that. It's a fully open source operating system for smart glasses that unlocks this new interface for devs and brings their apps into the hands (and on the faces) of users.
This is not another B2B SaaS. We're going to eat Apple and Google's lunch. Help us architect the OS for the next personal computer.

About the role
Paratus Health is building the AI-powered operations layer for outpatient clinics: agents that handle calls, intake, insurance, and documentation, fully integrated with EHRs like Epic and Athena.
We’re backed by Y Combinator and investors behind GitHub, Notion, and Vanta. We’re already live in hospitals (including Stanford), saving 8+ minutes per patient interaction and earning 90%+ satisfaction. Now, we’re scaling.
🔧 The Role
We’re looking for a
Founding Engineer
to help us architect and scale the future of healthcare automation. You'll be an early technical leader, working closely with the founders to ship products end-to-end, from AI voice agents to insurance verification and EHR integrations.
This is not just a job, it’s a chance to build something meaningful from the ground up.
What you’ll do
Own critical parts of the stack: AI voice agents, backend infra, EHR integrations
Build and ship fast - LLMs, pipelines, real-time systems
Work directly with clinics to prototype and launch
Set engineering direction and technical standards
Contribute to a high-trust, high-speed team culture
You might be a fit if you
Have 2–4 years of experience in fast-paced startups
Are a fullstack or backend-leaning engineer (75/25 split)
Know TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, and ideally LLMs (RAG + finetuning)
Can thrive in ambiguity and build 0→1
Bonus: experience with healthtech, EHRs, or voice/audio agents
Why Join Us
Ownership
: Meaningful equity and first engineer outside the founders
Product impact
: Your work directly improves clinical outcomes
Fast feedback loop
: You’ll ship to live clinics in week 1
In-person team
: Hybrid setup at Menlo Park HQ (101 Jefferson Dr)
Support
: DoorDash credits, L&D budget, flexible hours
Speed
: Our hiring process wraps in 5–7 days
Hiring Process
Intro Call (30 min):
A casual conversation with our CEO to learn about your background, what excites you, and why this opportunity resonates.
Technical Screen (30 min):
Deep dive with our CTO into your problem-solving skills and technical thinking. May include live coding, system design, or discussing past projects.
Take-home Assessment (4-6 hours, paid)

Final chat to ensure alignment on values, working style, and long-term vision. You'll meet both founders and get a feel for the team dynamic.

Paratus Health is transforming patient intake so doctors walk in fully informed and patients feel heard before the visit even begins.
Founded by Stanford AI engineers and backed by Y Combinator, we’re solving a problem we’ve lived ourselves: broken, inefficient patient intake. We’re an early-stage startup moving fast and hiring passionate people who want to reshape healthcare.

jobs.title: Materials Engineering - Summer 2026 Intern
jobs.description:
About the role
_Location: Atlanta, GA (In-Person)_
_Duration: 4 Months_
Team: Manufacturing | Mission: ENOS
About the Role
Reditus Space is seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Materials Engineering Intern to support the development and qualification of advanced thermal protection systems (TPS) for the ENOS reentry capsule. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates in materials science, chemical engineering, aerospace, or mechanical engineering — as well as trade school students with experience in composites or lab-based materials work. You’ll play a critical role in manufacturing TPS and supporting testing in cleanrooms and at NASA and partner facilities.
Responsibilities
Manufacture TPS materials using thermal cure and layup processes
Mix and handle thermoset resins and composite reinforcement fabrics
Prepare mechanical and thermal test specimens and assist in characterization
Support materials testing campaigns at NASA and partner facilities
Maintain detailed records of fabrication methods, procedures, and results
Qualifications
Student or recent graduate in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace/Mechanical Engineering, or technical trades
Hands-on experience with composites, polymers, or high-temperature materials preferred
Strong safety awareness and lab discipline when working with chemicals and thermal systems
Willingness to travel for testing and fieldwork
Eagerness to learn and contribute to a flight-critical subsystem
**Why Reditus Space?**
This is a unique opportunity to work directly on reentry materials with real flight hardware and collaborate with top-tier researchers and national labs. Exceptional interns may be invited to return for future programs or full-time roles.
AboutReditus Space
We build stuff that goes to space and back, we move fast and break stuff.

jobs.description:
About the role
Thermal Structures Engineer – Reditus Space
Location:
Atlanta, GA
Department:
Engineering – Structures
Employment Type:
Full-time
Role Overview
As a Thermal Structures Engineer, you will play a critical role in supporting the Lead Structures Engineer to ensure the ENOS spacecraft’s structural integrity and thermal resilience from design through flight. Your focus will be on stress analysis, structural verification and validation (V&V), and the design of fixturing and test systems for both qualification and acceptance testing. This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary position requiring close collaboration with design, manufacturing, and test teams to deliver robust, flight-ready hardware.
Key Responsibilities
Perform detailed stress analysis of spacecraft structures and components using both finite element analysis (FEA) tools (e.g., ANSYS, NASTRAN) and classical hand calculations to ensure compliance with strength and stiffness requirements under static, dynamic, and thermal loads.
Support structural verification and validation activities, including the development and execution of test plans for static, dynamic, vibration, and thermal environments in accordance with industry and NASA standards.
Design, develop, and document test fixtures and support equipment to enable accurate, flight-like structural and thermal testing of spacecraft hardware.
Correlate analytical models with test results, identify discrepancies, and drive corrective actions to improve structural performance and reliability.
Assist in the selection of materials and processes, considering thermal and mechanical properties, manufacturability, and mission environment.
Prepare and maintain detailed engineering documentation, including analysis reports, test procedures, and verification matrices.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (thermal, avionics, propulsion, manufacturing) to ensure integrated, high-performance spacecraft designs.
Support root cause analysis and troubleshooting of structural issues during integration and test campaigns.
Contribute to a culture of rapid iteration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
1+ years of experience in structural analysis, verification, and testing for aerospace or similarly demanding applications.
Proficiency with FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or similar) and 3D CAD software (NX, SolidWorks, or equivalent).
Hands-on experience designing and building test fixtures and support equipment for structural and thermal testing.
Strong understanding of metallic and composite materials, joining methods, and spaceflight hardware test requirements.
Experience with designing for reusability (design-life, thermal fatigue, and load cycles)
Familiarity with industry standards for structural and thermal qualification and acceptance testing (e.g., NASA-STD-7002B).
Excellent communication, documentation, and teamwork skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with reusable spacecraft or launch vehicle structural verification and validation.
Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping and hardware iteration.
Familiarity with spacecraft environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, acoustic).
Demonstrated ability to innovate and solve multidisciplinary engineering challenges.
Experience supporting integrated test campaigns and launch site operations.
What We Offer
The opportunity to build and fly hardware that will transform the future of space manufacturing.
A hands-on, high-impact engineering culture with rapid iteration, real responsibility, and minimal red tape.
Competitive salary and equity package with generous healthcare benefits.
The chance to work alongside some of the best engineers in the industry on high-impact problems.
An open, non-hierarchical environment where talent, drive, and results matter most.
Reditus Space is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
If you’re passionate about spacecraft structural analysis, verification, and hands-on test engineering, apply now to join Reditus Space and help build the future of space.

Strong understanding of electrical system architecture, power distribution, data buses (CAN, RS-422, Ethernet, SpaceWire), and communication protocols.

jobs.description:
About the role
The Mission
We're building an AI-powered insurance brokerage that's transforming the $900 billion commercial insurance market. Fresh off our $8M seed round, we need an exceptional AI Research Engineer to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents in the insurance domain. You'll be at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical implementation, directly improving the intelligence and reliability of our AI systems that are replacing pre-internet infrastructure.
You'll own the research and development of our model evaluation, alignment, and inference systems, ensuring our AI agents deliver reliable, accurate, and domain-specific responses across complex insurance workflows. This includes building our "MLLM-as-a-Judge" evaluation infrastructure, implementing post-training workflows (RLHF, DPO, RLAIF), optimizing inference infrastructure for production scale, and establishing rigorous benchmarking processes for insurance-specific reasoning tasks.
We're committed to "Staying REAL" with our AI systems - Reliable, Experience-focused, Accurate, and Low latency. You'll work directly with the CEO and CTO to rapidly experiment, evaluate, and deploy improvements to our AI agents. We live by "There is no try, there is just do" - we need researchers who ship production improvements, not just run experiments.
Outcomes You'll Drive
Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure
Design and build our "MLLM-as-a-Judge" evaluation system for automated, scalable feedback on insurance domain tasks
Establish comprehensive benchmarking processes comparing foundation models on underwriting, risk assessment, and policy recommendation tasks
Create insurance-specific evaluation datasets with human annotations for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning
Analyze model failure modes in insurance contexts and provide actionable improvements to the engineering team
Build real-time monitoring systems to track model performance degradation in production
Model Alignment & Post-Training
Implement and optimize post-training workflows including RLHF, DPO, GRPO, and RLAIF for insurance domain alignment
Experiment with inference-time alignment techniques (prompt engineering, RAG, ICL) to improve accuracy on insurance-specific queries
Build training automation pipelines and dashboards for reproducible experiments and rapid iteration
Fine-tune models for critical insurance tasks: underwriter reasoning, risk assessment, policy matching
Develop custom reward models specific to insurance domain requirements
Inference Optimization & Deployment
Deploy and optimize models using state-of-the-art inference frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI)
Implement advanced serving strategies including continuous batching, PagedAttention, and speculative decoding
Optimize GPU memory utilization through quantization (INT8/INT4), KV-cache optimization, and tensor parallelism
Build multi-model serving infrastructure supporting model routing based on task complexity
Implement model cascading strategies to balance latency, cost, and accuracy
Design and deploy A/B testing infrastructure for gradual model rollouts
Create comprehensive monitoring for inference metrics: p50/p95/p99 latencies, throughput, GPU utilization
Build automatic failover and model fallback systems for high availability
Research to Production Pipeline
Translate latest research in LLM evaluation, alignment, and efficient inference into production-ready solutions
Develop custom evaluation metrics for insurance-specific tasks (accuracy in premium calculations, regulatory compliance, risk assessment)
Build automated performance regression testing for model updates
Create feedback loops from production data to continuously improve model performance
Implement online learning capabilities for real-time model adaptation
Cross-functional Impact
Partner with platform engineers to integrate evaluation and inference systems into the AI Grid infrastructure
Collaborate with product teams to define SLA requirements and success metrics for AI agents
Work with forward deployed engineers to understand latency constraints and optimization opportunities
Build cost models to optimize inference spend while maintaining quality standards
You're Our Person If
Core Requirements
Deep understanding of transformer architectures and experience training/fine-tuning large language models
Hands-on experience with post-training techniques (RLHF, DPO, Constitutional AI, RLAIF)
Proven track record building evaluation systems and working with human-annotated datasets
Experience with distributed training on multi-GPU/multi-node systems
Strong proficiency with PyTorch and ecosystem tools (Torchtune, FSDP, DeepSpeed)
Experience deploying models to production with modern inference servers (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, Triton)
Experience translating research papers into production implementations
Comfort with both research experimentation and production engineering
You ship improvements daily and measure impact rigorously
Inference & Optimization Expertise
Deep understanding of GPU architecture and CUDA programming for performance optimization
Experience with model quantization techniques (GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, INT8/INT4)
Hands-on experience with efficient attention mechanisms (FlashAttention, PagedAttention, GQA, MQA)
Knowledge of advanced serving optimizations (continuous batching, dynamic batching, request scheduling)
Experience with model compression techniques (distillation, pruning, low-rank adaptation)
Proficiency in profiling and optimizing GPU kernels for inference workloads
Understanding of distributed inference patterns (tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism)
Experience with edge deployment and model optimization for resource-constrained environments
Technical Expertise
Experience building automated evaluation pipelines and "LLM-as-a-Judge" systems
Understanding of inference optimization techniques beyond quantization (speculative decoding, guided generation)
Familiarity with RAG systems and context engineering for domain-specific applications
Experience with experiment tracking and reproducible research infrastructure
Knowledge of prompt engineering and few-shot learning techniques
Understanding of multimodal models and cross-modal alignment (nice to have)
Experience with cost-performance optimization for large-scale inference
Mindset & Approach
You default to action: run the experiment instead of debating the approach
You're comfortable with ambiguity and can define your own success metrics
You balance research rigor with practical impact and shipping velocity
You obsess over latency budgets and cost-per-token metrics
You can explain complex ML concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
You're excited about applying AI to transform a massive, traditional industry
Hard Requirements
3+ years of experience in ML research or research engineering roles
Proven track record of improving LLM performance through alignment techniques
Demonstrated experience deploying models to production at scale
Experience optimizing inference for latency-sensitive applications
Strong understanding of GPU architecture and parallel computing
Experience with Python and modern ML frameworks
Published research or significant open-source contributions (bonus)
Experience with insurance or financial services domain (bonus)
Must be based in San Francisco and work in-office 5.5 days per week (relocation assistance provided)
Nice to Have
Contributions to open-source inference frameworks (vLLM, TGI, etc.)
Experience with custom CUDA kernel development
Knowledge of compiler optimizations for ML workloads
Experience with federated learning or privacy-preserving ML techniques
Background in formal verification or model safety
What We Offer
Opportunity to define how AI transforms a $900 billion industry
Direct impact on systems processing billions in insurance premiums
Work with cutting-edge AI technology and infrastructure
Extremely high ownership and autonomy
Competitive compensation with significant equity
Relocation assistance to San Francisco
This position offers the unique opportunity to bridge cutting-edge AI research with massive real-world impact. You'll push the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents while ensuring they operate reliably at scale in a highly regulated industry. If you're passionate about making AI systems faster, smarter, and more reliable, we want to talk to you.

Harper is nearing $5M ARR with clear line of sight to $10M ARR by Q1. We started in August of 2024 and were only at $400k of ARR in January. We're an AI-native insurance brokerage that's proven AI can work in traditional industries by building the systems ourselves first.
Why This Role Exists
We've been trying to put people with traditional backgrounds into operational roles, and they never scale themselves - they only grow linearly. We keep needing to add more of them. We realized we need a different type of operator to create the leverage we need, where theoretically one person can handle 10,000 customers.
The best person to do this is someone who's scrappy and looking to ultimately build a workflow automation or AI-type company. So we decided to post a job for future AI founders. There'll be a lot of hard work, but you'll learn how to actually do AI automation directly and learn about insurance - a massive field you might want to start a business in. Because you'll be bought in, I can also teach you about being a founder and give you exposure to running a company.

About the role
About Karsa
At Karsa, we’re building the global dollar account—enabling millions of people in emerging markets to protect their savings from currency volatility through stablecoins.
Over 1B people live in economies with severe inflation, losing hundreds of billions of dollars each year in savings, fees, and time spent navigating broken financial systems and black-market exchanges. In these countries, stablecoins offer a lifeline to financial stability.
Karsa allows them to hold dollars and earn steady yield, spend anywhere with a card, and remit money across the world—faster and cheaper than ever before. We’ve already launched with active users across Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Kenya, and Paraguay, rapidly expanding to additional markets. We’re backed by YC and the best investors in our industry, deeply experienced in crypto, and dedicated to providing financial freedom to billions.
The Role
As a founding engineer at Karsa, you'll be integral to shaping our product from the ground up. You'll own significant portions of our technical stack and drive critical infrastructure decisions, directly impacting users in some of the world's most economically challenging regions.
In particular, you’ll focus on building and scaling the backend systems that power our product, from integrating crypto wallets and fintech rails, to managing secure user data and building cloud infrastructure. The role requires adaptability, broad technical range, and a strong focus on security.
Who you are:
Mission-driven: We’re building tools that can protect a family’s savings in a collapsing economy. This is an incredibly challenging, decade-long sprint, but if we succeed, it changes everything—from individual lives to national systems. This weight should matter to you.
Founder mindset: You’re not an IC. You’re our partner. You need to be highly opinionated on our product and market, be ready to work on anything, and drive our direction from day one.
Hungry: We work 6–7 days a week, often late into the night, since our users don’t live on a 9-5. The two of us put together a stablecoin bank + cross-border payments + a card in <3 months. We’re not looking for a big team. We need a force multiplier.
What You'll Do:
Implement and optimize integrations with crypto infrastructure providers (Wallet infrastructure, On/off ramps, payment service providers, stablecoin issuers).
Architect secure, performant, and reliable backend services with Next.js and AWS.
Design and manage high-throughput databases (Postgres), ensuring data integrity and security.
Collaborate closely with the founders to define product strategies, iterate quickly, and ship impactful features.
What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About the role
San Francisco · Full-time · In-person
About Solidroad
Building something great is addictive. It's like discovering your favorite TV show mid-season, except you're helping write the next episode. It's like unboxing a new gadget, except you're the one designing it. You shape how it feels, how it works, and how people react when they use it.
At Solidroad we're solving a big, messy, exciting problem: how do you scale customer support without losing what makes humans amazing? Warmth, empathy, intuition. We're using AI, generative tech, and real-time simulations to make this happen. It's ambitious, difficult, and genuinely new.
About the role
We're looking for a senior designer who sees this role as more than just a job. It should feel like signing up for a job and a hobby. Or a job and a triathlon. Or a job and an advanced art course. You'll shape our design decisions, own major parts of our product experience, mentor your teammates, and push yourself in ways you might not expect. It'll stretch your skills and fill your life in a deeply rewarding way. You'll craft impactful designs (product interfaces, brand systems, marketing assets; it's all on the table), and make critical decisions about user experience, visual direction, and product feel. There will be challenging moments, but also regular moments of genuine "wow, we built that" pride.
What you'll actually do day-to-day
Design the Complete Product Experience Stack
Shape Brand Evolution Across All Touchpoints
Drive Exceptional User Experience Standards
Our Team & Culture
We're a small, focused group working full-time in our San Francisco office. We're here five days a week because building something ambitious means collaborating closely, solving problems together, sharing ideas spontaneously, and occasionally challenging each other to padel matches, cold plunges, or karaoke evenings. We're intentional about creating a culture that's mature, supportive, and fun. You'll be joining experienced founders who've done this before, alongside a tight-knit team genuinely excited about building something impactful.
We hope you
Have at least 4 years of design experience, ideally at a startup (Series A to C), where you've helped ship complex, customer-facing products that real people love using.
Bring strong design leadership, including experience mentoring other designers, leading design decisions, or owning significant product areas from concept to launch.
Have deep expertise in modern design tools, design systems, or AI/tech product design—bonus points if you've worked on notable or challenging projects we can explore together.
The good, the bad, and the honest truth
The highs here are incredibly high, direct collaboration with founders who've done this before, significant ownership, and a product you'll feel deeply proud of. The lows are that you'll need to move fast, navigate ambiguity, and sometimes tackle tough design problems solo. But the reality is that startups are a bit like a sport or an instrument: you invest in it not just because you have to, but because you genuinely want to be better tomorrow than you are today.
If that sounds exciting, don't second-guess yourself. Get in touch. Send us something you've designed that you're proud of (portfolio, case studies, anything goes) and a short note about who you are and why this feels right to you. We value enthusiasm, ambition, and curiosity just as much as your design experience.
AboutSolidroad
🎯 What Problem We’re Solving
If you've ever had a frustrating customer support interaction, you've experienced firsthand the problem Solidroad is tackling. Most companies want to provide outstanding customer experiences but struggle to scale quality interactions without increasing costs and complexity.
Solidroad
is solving this by building an
AI-driven quality assurance and training platform
that enables customer support teams to deliver exceptional experiences consistently and efficiently. Our platform automatically analyzes 100% of customer interactions, provides real-time insights, and creates personalized training simulations to dramatically enhance support quality.
Joining Solidroad means you're directly shaping the future of customer experience, making every interaction between businesses and customers faster, more effective, and genuinely human—powered by the ideal blend of AI and human empathy.

jobs.description:
About the role
We’re discovering new, safer pesticides using AI because pests are evolving resistance faster than industry can innovate, As a result, global pestcide usage has doubled per acre in the past 20 years, while pest-losses stay the same. We’re looking for a highly organized detail-oriented Laboratory Technician to join our fast-moving team and help solve this problem. This role centers around creating and analyzing dose–response curves, IC50 determination (biochemical), and working with live insects. You must have strong quantitative and analytical skills to generate clear, reproducible results.
What you’ll do
Perform IC50 assays, create dose–response curves, perform in-vivo (insect) efficacy testing, and operate analytical instruments (e.g., plate readers, spectrophotometers).
Use in-house Python tools analyze, visualize, interpret, and log experimental results with accuracy and clarity.
Maintain extreme organization, detailed records, and clear communication, while solving problems and adapting protocols as needed.
Qualifications
Proficiency in
enzyme activity assays
and how enzymes work,
IC50 determination
, and
dose–response curve analysis
, with comfort working directly with live insects.
Strong foundation in
statistics, critical thinking, and problem solving
, with proven ability to work independently and methodically.
Experience with basic
Python
for data analysis and visualization.
AboutBindwell
We use AI to discover new pesticides, because the ones we have now are failing — pests keep evolving, and the chemicals kill too many other things (like humans). Our models replace slow, expensive lab work, letting us discover new molecules 100× faster. Our first pesticide targets a Spodoptera with a novel mode of action. We’re a small team of young engineers from Caltech & Wolfram Research, with experience in drug discovery ML models, rebuilding agrochemical R&D around AI.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
ABOUT US
Pickle is building the future of human connection, starting with your AI clone.
In a world where reach is abundant but depth is rare, we’re rethinking how people express themselves and form meaningful relationships. Our goal is ambitious: to give everyone a living, human-like digital clone that can think, speak, and feel like you, so you can scale who you are, not just what you do.
We’re a small team of builders, designers, and researchers backed by Y Combinator, NFX, Krew Capital, and BASS Ventures. We move fast, work hard, and care deeply. Our culture is built on intensity, imagination, and long-term craftsmanship. We believe this is the start of a new era—where the digital self becomes an extension of the human self—and we’re here to shape it from first principles.
Our mission is to help people scale strong ties by scaling the self.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Pickle is looking for exceptional AI engineers to help us build the first truly human AI clone—real time, expressive, and persistent across voice, video, and memory. As a founding researcher, you’ll work at the frontier of multimodal learning, diffusion models, NeRFs, and real-time generation. Your work will shape how clones understand context, express emotion, and adapt over time, thus bringing deeply personal, interactive AI to life.
ABOUT THE RESPONSIBILITIES
Research and develop multimodal models that combine voice, video, and text to create deeply human-like AI clones.
Push the frontier on expressiveness and realism using techniques like diffusion models, NeRFs, and 3DGS.
Prototype and fine-tune models for real-time performance, identity preservation, and long-term contextual memory.
Collaborate closely with engineers and designers to bring cutting-edge research into a seamless, user-facing product.
AboutPickle
Pickle is an early-stage team building a new foundation for human connection in the age of AI. We’re rethinking the digital self, creating interactive AI clones that don’t just speak like you, but learn like you, think like you, and represent who you are. In a world saturated with reach, we’re building for depth, architecting the infrastructure to form real, lasting relationships at scale. Our mission is ambitious: to scale strong ties by scaling the self.
We’re building a persistent AI avatar that speaks in your voice, learns from your behavior, and connects on your behalf whether you’re asleep, focused, or on the other side of the world. Our work spans real-time multimodal modeling, interactive memory systems, and identity architecture. We’re not building tools that generate AI avatars. We’re defining a new interface between humans and machines, where presence is continuous and connection happens with the speed of thought and the scale of software.
We’re a small team of builders who move fast, go deep, and care personally. We work ruthlessly not out of obligation, but because we believe the next computing layer won’t come from a roadmap, but from relentless iteration and full immersion. We value speed, precision, and taste. Our culture isn’t meetings and policies. It’s curiosity, code, and conviction.
If you’re obsessed with hard problems and driven to shape how humanity interacts with machines, we’d love to meet you.
— The Pickle Team

You have exceptional taste and a passion for creating beautiful, polished user experiences
You want to define how millions of people will interact with AI agents, shaping the future of AI-human collaboration
You care deeply about making every customer interaction an absolute delight

You can ruthlessly prioritize between building the perfect feature and shipping quickly to deliver immediate value

Experience with a mature React codebase
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Design or a closely related technical field

Establish and maintain a robust design system, reusable component libraries, and UI standards

We’re David & Joe, both AI engineers.

jobs.title: Founding Principal Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
What you’ll do:
As founding principal hardware engineer, you will lead the design and in-production implementation of an exchange and co-located trading facility on a single silicon device. You will lead development of PAX core technology and set future design directions.
PAX ultra low-latency in-silicon matching engine:
PAX is building the world's first exchange and co-located trading facility on a chip. We will go-to-market using AWS F2 FPGA instances and follow-on with an ASIC design that combines network aggregation with exchange functionality.
PAX provides the fastest tick-to-trade and market data publication in the world, across all exchanges (e.g. faster than NYSE, Deutsche Börse, etc.).
Exchange integrated high frequency trading logic:
The PAX λ API provides traders with on-chip exchange integrated HFT decision logic. Using the λ API, traders can make markets or take arbitrage opportunities. The λ API enables traders to respond to market events the very instant the information is registered in the exchange matching engine.
PAX business model:
PAX sells access to its ultra-low latency λ API and offers trading otherwise for free. Existing exchanges typically offer rebates for liquidity providers ("makers") and charge fees to liquidity takers (the "maker/taker" fee structure). At PAX when λ and non-λ orders pair together, the free-tier order is given a cash rebate regardless of whether their order was characterized as making or taking. PAX is the first exchange to offer zero-fee trading and rebates for both making and taking.
Deep dives on PAX market structure & technology:
On-exchange trading incentives with inherent price competition
.
PAX rebates & fees
.
PAX λ API
.
Relevant background:
Candidates with experience in high frequency trading (HFT) or at an exchange are encouraged to apply.
Skills:
SystemVerilog
FPGA or ASIC design experience
Rust and/or C++
HFT
Protobuf
Curiosity and ability to learn
Passion for trading and markets
AboutPAX Markets
Exchange on a chip
PAX (
link
) is building an exchange on a chip. We co-locate high frequency trading (HFT) logic directly onto the same silicon device where we run our core exchange matching engine.
We move traders to within nanometers of the exchange. Such proximity unlocks unprecedented value to high frequency customers and PAX shares this value by offering zero-fees & cash-back, to every other market participant on every trade.
Crypto go-to-market
PAX will start operating its exchange first in crypto, offering spot & perps for BTC & ETH. Crypto is a fast growing space with $1T+ in daily volume.
Technology that spans asset classes
After growing in crypto, PAX will establish a U.S equities ATS and continue to monetize by operating exchanges in every asset class and every global market.
