About the role
The Opportunity
careCycle is transforming the Medicare insurance distribution industry with AI voice assistants that make every senior feel like a regular at their local diner, and a new system of record (CRM, dialer) that displaces billons in market cap.
We've processed over 1 million calls for 15 clients and are scaling to 45+ in the next quarter as we head into AEP (Annual Enrollment Period) - Medicare's Super Bowl. We’re at 7-figure ARR 5 months out of the batch, and still doubling month over month. Voice experiences were our wedge product. Now we’re going after the entire tech stack, with an opportunity to serve over 200,000 agents and 40 million seniors.
We need a founding solutions engineer who thrives at the intersection of talking to customers, prompt engineering, and getting into the weeds on improving product (voice AI orchestration, function calling, infrastructure).
You'll be owner #5 on our founding team, directly responsible for getting clients live and ensuring our voice AI bots deliver magical experiences for seniors navigating Medicare.
What You'll Own
Client Implementation (60% of time)
Transform client requirements into working voice AI campaigns within 48-72 hours
Build and configure voice assistant bots using our Pipecat-based platform (Mobius) Create custom integrations with client CRMs, call tracking systems, and carrier APIs
Own the technical relationship from contract signature through go-live
Engineer for scale: Influence product and internal FDE processes that prepare us to go from 10s to 100s of customers
System Optimization & Scaling (30% of time)
Listen to call recordings and identify patterns across our 5-6K daily calls
Build quantitative monitoring for latency, pipeline crashes, and performance issues
Test and implement new STT/TTS/LLM models across AWS Sagemaker Create reusable templates and patterns that turn 10-hour implementations into 1-hour configurations Product & Customer Bridge (10% of time)
Translate field learnings into product requirements
Join late-stage sales calls to scope technical requirements
Contribute to our technical documentation and knowledge base
Technical Requirements
Must-Haves:
Demonstrated excellence and passion for great conversational AI experiences (Ideally in the voice modality)
3-5+ years building production software (Python required, JavaScript a plus)
Experience with APIs, webhooks, and system integrations Comfort with AWS (bonus: Sagemaker, Lambda, CloudWatch)
Ability to debug complex distributed systems
Nice-to-Haves:
Experience with voice/telephony systems (Twilio, VoIP, SIP)
Background in ML/AI implementation (not just using ChatGPT)
Previous startup or founding experience (44% of successful FDEs are former founders)
Healthcare/insurance industry knowledge
Who You Are
Owner Mentality:
You see a problem and fix it without being asked
Customer Obsessed: You get energy from making customers successful
Technical Translator: You can explain complex voice AI to non-technical insurance executives
Speed Demon: You ship fast, iterate faster, and aren't precious about perfect code
Systems Thinker: You solve for 100 clients, not just the one in front of you
Red Flags (Please Don't Apply If...)
You want to only write code without talking to customers
You need extensive specifications before starting work
You view customer calls as interruptions rather than learning opportunities
You're looking for work-life balance (this is an intense founding role)
Compensation & Benefits
$120-180K base salary
0.5-2.5% equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
Up to 20% performance-based bonus tied to client success metrics
Full health/dental/vision
Equipment budget
About the interview
30-min founder screen (Alex, CEO)
Technical deep-dive with CTO (Evan) - system design + live debugging Customer scenario roleplay - scope a Medicare agency's needs
Take-home: Configure a simple voice bot (3-hour timeboxed)
Reference checks
Paid 1-week onsite in San Francisco. At this point, we intend on hiring you

jobs.title: Backend/Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Our Mission
America’s defense industrial base runs on infrastructure built in the 1980s. Distributors and manufacturers managing our supply chain still manually stitch together email threads, supplier quotes, PDFs, government solicitations, and archaic ERP exports to manage billions of dollars passing through our supply chain in component level assemblies.
SalesPatriot changes that.
We're building the AI-native command center for U.S. defense logistics, eliminating the manual bottlenecks slowing down critical national security workflows. From F-35 bearings to Blackhawk rotor hubs, we’re helping distributors and manufactures quote faster, win more, and deliver the parts that keep America safe.
Quick Facts
YC W25 company — Top 5% growth in batch
$1M+ ARR in under 90 days — on track for $5M+ this summer
Trusted by 1,231+ manufacturers across aerospace and defense
Backed by YC, SV Angel, Pear VC, and CRV (Raised 5M Seed at 50M valuation)
We co-live in SF — seriously. We build fast and thrive in the chaos.
We work 12–15 hour days because we’re obsessed with the mission — not because anyone’s asking us to
What You’ll Work On
Architect Semi-Structured Data Flows
Build pipelines that ingest and normalize chaotic inputs (PDFs, Excel, emails, legacy ERP dumps) into structured formats ready for decision-making. Think Palantir Foundry, but tailor built for managing supply-chain at a massive scale.
Design Human-in-the-Loop Agents Systems
All of our AI deployments are phased: first, we build UIs that help humans execute and annotate workflows. Then, we inject agents into those flows using the collected data. You’ll help build both phases — human control, then AI augmentation along with the internal tooling that helps us do this at scale.
Operational UI & Frontend Infra
Build the frontends that power this phased rollout — allowing operators to view, validate, override, and gradually hand off work to intelligent agents. We don’t believe in “AI magic” we focus on real-world collaboration between software and people.
AI-Powered Quoting at Scale
Enable intelligent parsing and automated responses for hundreds of inbound emails a day. Build backend flows that transform noise into fast communication.
AI Backtesting & Deployment Frameworks
Develop tooling to test agents on historical data, simulate outcomes, and safely deploy into live environments — all backed by version-controlled workflows.
AI-Enhanced Data Input Interfaces
Build intelligent Excel-style tools that let users map any column layout into SQL-backed formats — powered by chain of thought reasoning and schema inference.
Own End-to-End Systems
From front-end UI to back-end pipelines to model prompts — you’ll touch every layer and own it through shipping, iteration, and scale.
Internal Tooling
Build fast, flexible tools for our FDE’s to deploy new agent workflows, debug outputs, and monitor performance.
Who You Are
Full-stack & Versatile:
You thrive across the stack and learn new tools fast.
High Intensity Operator:
You’re allergic to slow, safe projects.
Scrappy:
Whether it’s cleaning CSVs or writing complex ETL, you’ll do whatever it takes.
Opinionated but Curious:
You speak up, argue well, and change your mind with evidence.
In-Person Ready:
You’re ready to build in SF, in our house, with our team.
Why Join Us
Founding Experience:
Help define the culture, roadmap, and the team from the ground up.
Real Equity:
You’ll own a meaningful slice of a rocket ship.
Direct National Impact:
Your work will influence how defense logistics function in the U.S. — literally.
Immediate Feedback Loop:
No waiting around — you’ll see your work change lives in days.
No B-Team:
You’ll work with brilliant, gritty teammates who push hard and play to win.
🚨
All roles are on-site in San Francisco. We live together, We work together.
🏡
Living expenses fully covered. Food and Housing is taken care of (
https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/23-Robinhood-Dr-San-Francisco-CA-94127/15135754_zpid/?mmlb=g,22
).
What It’s Like
Let’s be real — it’s intense.
We pivot fast, work late, and fight fires constantly. But we’re building something real. Something that reshapes how the defense world moves. If you want certainty, a manager with a spec, or a cozy corporate vibe — this isn’t for you.
But if you thrive on adrenaline, learning fast, and building hard things with people you respect — you’ll feel right at home.
Who Thrives Here
You’ve launched a side project, jumped out of planes, or shipped something everyone said was too hard. You're:
Unconventional:
You don’t follow playbooks — you write them.
Bold:
You take risks, move fast, and fail forward.
Independent:
You don’t need a spec to get started — you figure it out.
Relentless:
Every problem is just a puzzle you haven’t solved yet.
We’re Redefining How Defense Distributors Operate.
💥 Don’t see your role? Apply anyway. If you’re exceptional, we’ll make room.
Reach out. Show us what you’ve got. Simple as that.
AboutSalesPatriot

About the role
About the role
Weave (YC W25) is hiring a founding engineer. At Weave, we’re building the best software for the best engineering teams to move faster, and we want to hire exceptional engineers to help us do so.
We are a well-funded startup, backed by top investors, growing rapidly and currently profitable.
You'll be working directly with me (Andrew), the CTO. Before I was CTO of Weave I was the founding engineer at Causal, and I want to give you all the support and growth opportunities in this role that I got when I went through it.
You’ll also be working directly with Adam, the CEO. Adam runs sales at Weave, and before that worked as a sales executive at a few different high growth startups.
Must haves
You are a good fit for Weave if you are a
formidable
engineer. This means you stop at nothing to accomplish your goal. We don't care much about your current skills or even what you've done before; we care that you will be able to do anything you set your mind to.
You must also be pragmatic. Weave is a startup so something is always on fire. You need to know when to let little fires burn and when to break out the extinguisher.
You must be a very good engineer who's committed to becoming a great engineer. The slope is more important than the Y-intercept.
You must be empathetic. We're building products for other people, so you need to be able to understand how other people think and why.
You must care about helping other software engineering teams be great. If that's not an exciting mission for you, it will be hard to stay motivated through the inevitable highs and lows.
You must be an excellent communicator. You’ll be working on a product that’s communicating with millions of engineers and leaders, so you need to be clear.
Finally you must be gritty. You should be accustomed to picking the hard option and pushing through it.
Nice to haves
(Please feel free to apply even if some or all of these don't apply to you!)
Our tech stack is React + TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, and Python for ML. Experience with any of those three languages is a bonus.
If you've already done lots of thinking about engineering productivity and how to improve it, that's great and we want to hear about it!
We hope your design sensibilities are passable.
The role
As Weave’s founding product engineer, your job is to build things customers want. This involves any/all of:
Talking to customers to understand their pain points and requests
Designing and planning potential solutions
Writing the backend for a new feature
Writing the frontend for a new feature
Provisioning the infrastructure to support a new feature
Releasing the feature and collecting customer feedback on it

Repeat!

jobs.title: Founding Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Recruiters: we only want to hear from applicants. Emails from recruiters will be marked as spam.
Here’s the deal:
We’re building a world where every doctor can run their practice with zero support staff. We do this by building vertical AI agents that automate a clinic’s back office operations.
We grew 30x during the W25 batch, just closed our seed round, already have a mature GTM motion in place, but now we need to build our product to be capable of handling 140k dental clinics.
As a Lead Founding Engineer, you will work with the CTO in  developing and maintaining the product with a small talented team of other founding employees. There is a lot to build, but you won’t be alone. You will be joined by a team of experienced founders, builders, designers, and dreamers. Amongst us are people who have raised over $100m. Scaled businesses to $12m ARR in 18 months. We have people who were instrumental in the earliest days of some of the largest dental software companies around today.
What does Toothy offer you?
Toothy is early-stage, and our biggest challenges are all engineering-oriented. You will be instrumental to the success of this company, and those that it serves. We are a small team but we have a lot of resources and connections at our disposal that are atypical of a startup our size.
There is a real opportunity to do something big here, and when we succeed, you will reap the rewards that go with that. This is the most important position that we will hire for at this stage of the company; you will feel that when you work here.
Tech Stack
We’re primarily a Python shop, and thus all our core infrastructure is built in Python. However one of our founders is a fullstack React/Node dev, and thus any app with an interface gets built in JS.
What we need you to do (or help others do):
Be a cracked 10x engineer:
We want Neos not Smiths.
Work with CTO to manage engineering operations:
Harass development partners, sift through insurance docs, overcommunicate with engineers, oh my!
Architect and build
: Rapidly deploy new product features in Python, ensuring robust APIs, data flows, and back-end services that can scale.
Maintain operational stability
: Troubleshoot and resolve high-priority issues, often in complex on-prem/cloud-hybrid environments (e.g., Windows bots, remote workstations).
Data modeling & version control
: Design and maintain data pipelines for patient eligibility, claims, and other healthcare data, with rigorous version tracking.
Infrastructure & DevOps
: Help manage multi-region networking (low-latency requirements, NAT traversal, secure connections to windows environments), CI/CD, and logging/monitoring pipelines.
Windows RPA
: Evolve our in-house screen-scraping/automation bots, and ensure they can scale to tens of thousands of clinics.
Healthcare EDI
: Integrate X12 standards (270/271, 837/277) and design solutions to parse, map, and store eligibility data in a standardized LLM-readable format.
LLM / NLP workflows
: Build multi-stage pipelines that convert structured EDI data to English and back. Oversee logging and observability (LangFuse or similar).
AI Phone calls:
Build agents that place calls to insurance payers for a wide range of use cases.
Security & compliance
: Implement best practices for HIPAA, manage MFA across remote desktops/jumphosts, SOC2/HITRUST
Internal dashboards & tooling
: Create user-facing dashboards and admin tools for claims, eligibility, usage metrics, etc., ensuring secure role-based access.
Collaborate cross-functionally
: Work with founders, engineers, designers, and sales to deliver features in an iterative, fast-paced environment.
Relevant Experience
4+ years of software engineering
across a variety of domains and technologies.
Proficiency in Python
(our primary back-end) or a track record of picking up new languages/frameworks rapidly.
Healthcare / EDI knowledge
is a huge plus (270/271, 837/277, payer integration).
DevOps & Networking
: Comfortable with multi-cloud, NAT traversal, containerization, CI/CD, logging/monitoring, and infrastructure security.
Data Engineering:
Experience setting up reliable pipelines for dashboards, tracking, large batch jobs is a plus
Building scalable systems from scratch:
Experience owning projects where you had to start at nothing and scale to processing work at a large scale is a huge plus
Windows automation / RPA
: Experience building or maintaining screen-scraping bots or RPA solutions is highly desirable.
LLM / NLP
: Familiarity with prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, or multi-stage pipeline design.
AI Voice phone calls:
Speech-to-text, text-to-speech integration with LLM, IVR scripting and automation (VAPI, LiveKit, Amazon Voice Connector, Twilio, or comparable) or custom NLP for payer phone trees. Extra credit for high-volume call handling.
EHR/PMS:
Any experience interfacing practice managements systems or EHRs is a huge plus
Security & Compliance
: Understanding of HIPAA or other regulated environments. Any exposure to SOC2/HITRUST is beneficial.
Strong communication
: Ability to tell compelling stories about your work and present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Startup grit
: You’ve thrived on small, tight-knit teams before. You iterate quickly, learn constantly, and adapt on the fly.
About Toothy
At Toothy, we’re enabling doctors to focus on what’s most important: patient care. We strive to ship the highest quality products while working at the pace that a startup environment demands. As a startup, our team and culture is built around transparency, integrity, and trust with a passion to meet our larger mission and goal. We believe when our employees thrive our service flourishes.
Toothy is automating all of the mundane back office work that a dental practice needs to do to deliver patient care. Gathering insurance benefits, submitting & following up on claims, depositing checks, and a whole lot more, we do this so the clinic doesn’t have to. We deliver this through LLMs, AI voice, and a lot of ingenuity.  We believe we are only scratching the service on a vast opportunity in this market, and we are looking for amazing and passionate people to help deliver an outstanding experience for doctors and patients.
AboutToothy AI
We automate backoffice operations for dental clinics using LLMs.

jobs.title: Summer AI Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About the role
About Promptless
When most people want to use AI for work, they don’t want to build prompt libraries, engineer context windows, or decide between different foundation models—they just want solutions that integrate with the tools they’re already using and fit directly into their existing workflows. At Promptless, we’re building AI teammates that combine context-aware agents and embedded user experiences to deliver AI products that are accessible to everyone.
We’re starting with an AI teammate that automatically updates customer-facing docs, like tutorials, API references, and support centers. We were one of the top companies in the W25 batch by revenue, and our product is already used by both startups and Fortune 500 enterprises, and we’re struggling to keep up with the demand for our product.
Our small founding team has led teams at fast-growing startups, published LLM research, competed in national and international olympiads (including the IMO), and graduated from top schools like Stanford, Yale, and Harvard.
About the role
At Promptless, everyone on the team (including interns!) works on the most critical problems at the company. Even as a Summer Intern, on a typical day you can expect to be talking to customers, working with founders to design and implement features that solve customers’ problems, shipping code, and seeing customers use the features that you just built.
For an AI-engineering focused role, we expect great candidates to have experience building applications using LLMs (side projects count!) and excel at experimentation and learning new techniques (the tools change so quickly!). Bonus points if you’ve published relevant research or contributed to open-source AI projects.
Join us in San Francisco for an incredible summer!
About the interview
You’ll chat with me (Prithvi), demonstrate your technical skills with one of our engineers, and join the team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About Scout
Scout is the AI-native operating system for schools.
Our first product, Scout SIS, is a student information system (SIS). At its core, the SIS a database for schools to store student and staff data. Every school has an SIS, but it’s one of the lowest NPS products in the history of software. jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
For a more in-depth version review:
https://chrome-aletopelta-1ec.notion.site/Edexia-Founding-AI-Software-Engineer-22550912959780059b9cec238c1bf1f6?source=copy_link
Mission
Fix education.
Vision
A world where every learner has access to personalised, world-class education that fosters curiosity, critical thinking, and purpose.
Hiring, Culture & Expectations
We want to build a trillion-dollar company with ≤30 people by hiring the smartest, most driven people in the world and using AI to amplify our capabilities. We are effectively looking to hire young Elon Musks.
Three Core Evaluation Criteria:
Intelligence
: Historical achievements, problem-solving ability, confidence in tackling complex challenges
Drive:
Have you worked 80+ hours a week most of your life? Do you have an insatiable amount of curiosity? Are you willing to think about Edexia every second of your waking hours?
Cultural:
Do you care about our vision for education? Do you work for impact, not for profit? Are you a good moral person?
Work Culture & Expectations
We have a culture of ruthless life optimization to accomplish our vision. That doesn't mean staring at a computer for 16 hours 7 days a week, it means continuous optimization of every single aspect of our lives. We have the perfect sleep routine, diet, exercise, everything. We work 7 days a week but not always in front of a laptop — we are constantly going for quick walks to think big picture, or going for a company hike to discuss direction. We expect you to be OBSESSED with Edexia, it is your life, your everything, and we do WHATEVER it takes to accomplish our vision and positively impact the world. We understand you might not share that exact vision right now, but we want you to share a vision for a better world.
Technical Challenges & Role Responsibilities
As part of our team, you'll work on challenges that both move the needle for our mission and align with your strengths—whether that's AI architecture, UI/UX, reinforcement learning, or data engineering.
Detail
Assessment is our strategic starting point. We need to solve two core technical challenges:
1. Human-AI Alignment: Interpreting RubricsProblem:
Rubrics use vague terms like "informed" vs "adequate," causing inconsistent evaluation.
Solutions:
Rubric unpacking workflows, real-time voice AI training coaches, and reinforcement learning from teacher corrections.
2. Complex Marking: Accurately Evaluating Student WorkProblem:
Assessment requires hundreds of decisions across any format (typed, handwritten, graphs) and subject area.
Solutions:
Multi-agent workflows, OCR/computer vision systems, task-specific analysis modules, and clear feedback conversion.
Both require
two-level optimization:
System level:
Breaking problems into flexible multi-agent infrastructures
Individual agent level:
Optimizing each component with evaluation, prompting, fine-tuning, and custom models as needed
Who Should Apply
You want to be part of a small elite founding team
You have a huge desire to do something great in the world and can see yourself becoming obsessed with fixing the education system
You are excited, rather than concerned that you will be living and working out of one shared company house and "working" 24/7 towards one central vision with some of the smartest most driven people in the world
You want to change the world, and potentially found your own company someday (which we will help you do btw and make the Edexia Mafia >> PayPal Mafia)
Who Should NOT Apply
You want to have a "work-life balance"
Note: It's fine if you want to eventually get to a point where you have a work-life balance in 2-5 years. But you at least have to be willing to go through a period where you have no balance at all.
You don't think you can survive working 24/7 (not necessarily in front of a computer but thinking about ways to solve the problem constantly)
You are not confident in your ability to keep up
You largely care about your personal finances
You just want to solve intellectual puzzles, not real-world problems that will impact the world, sometimes (mostly not) our problems are more boring than intellectual problems and require a level of drive that can’t be built on curiosity alone.
About the interview
Zoom Call 1 (~30 minutes): Initial Introductions
Opportunity for you to ask any questions you are curious about (product, vision, history, etc.)
Zoom Call 2 (~60 minutes): Cultural Interview with Daniel (CEO)
Assessment of alignment with our company culture by deep dive into your career motivations, values, and long-term goals
Zoom Call 3 (~60 minutes): Semi-Technical Interview with Nathan (CTO)
Review of your technical background, coding experience, and problem-solving approach
Zoom Call 4 (~60 minutes): Logistics and Closing Call with Daniel (CEO)
Some quick follow-up questions & discussion over logistics with 1 week trial.
1 Week Paid Trial
You work on real projects with our team, in person (we will fly you out if needed)
Full-Time Offer
AboutEdexia

jobs.description:
About the role
About Asha Health
Asha Health is building the future of self-learning for healthcare generative AI. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, 186 Ventures, Reach Capital and many more. We recently raised an oversubscribed seed round from some of the best investors in Silicon Valley. Our team includes AI product leaders from companies like Google, physician executives from major health systems, and more.
About the Role
We're looking for an "insanely cracked engineer" to join our engineering team. We're looking for someone who is an all-rounder, but has particularly exceptional backend engineering skills. Our ideal candidate has built AI agents and leveraged clever engineering techniques to improve latency & reliability for complex workflows.
This role will be in person working with the 2 founders 6 days per week, so safe to say you will get close! If you are a go-getter and have the intensity it takes to win, this role could be for you. If this does not align with your current goals it may not be the best fit and we would recommend you do not apply.
Responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build state-of-the-art AI agents across several modalities. You will be horizontal across our engineering team, experimenting and implementing novel AI/ML techniques to improve performance and reliability of various AI agents.
You'll get to wear many hats. Here is some of the fun stuff you will do:
Develop AI agents with industry-leading performance for high stakes use cases in healthcare.
Architect our data annotation, fine tuning, and RLHF workflows.
Push the bleeding-edge in what is technically feasible!
Act like a owner — propose ideas and call your own shots!
Impact hundreds of thousands (hopefully millions) of patient lives!
Win.
Requirements
Graduated with a bachelors in computer science or related degree.
Very strong backend experience, preferably in 0-1 or 1-10 environments.
Worked at an early stage startup (Seed - Series C) before.
Experience building AI agents before with a high degree for reliability (we will ask you to impress us with the clever backend engineering techniques you've used).
Must be ready to work in person in Manhattan, New York 5 days per week in person but 6 days per week total.
Bonus:
Built and scaled your own projects to significant revenue.
Understanding of US healthcare/health-tech.
Why the heck should you work at Asha Health?
#1 We’ve got problems. A lot of them. Particularly, the really tough, barely possible, yet really fascinating to engineer kind. Come live on the ~~cutting~~ bleeding edge.
Everyone on our team pushes the boundaries of self-learning and applied AI within high stakes industries. We collaborate with leading companies in this space to unlock new capabilities every 2 weeks that weren’t possible before. Nearly all of our engineering work is on the cusp of applied AI: just barely possible, requires research & experimentation, but once we figure it out we ship it and it makes a lot of impact.
#2 It feels good to care:
A“job” can sometimes feel like selling a piece of your soul for money. But when you join an early stage startup, you’re not really signing up for a job. You’re embarking on a “mission”, an unrelenting pursuit in which you dare to try to bend the universe around your vision, knowing that if in the off-chance it works, nothing will ever be the same.
Our only guarantee to you is that your mission, should you choose to accept it, will get you out of bed excited, with anticipation, probably kind of scared (?) — but you’ll care and that’ll feel refreshing. How do we know that? Because we understand a few fundamental truisms about the world, and about you:
There’s nothing more exhilarating than swinging big even when the odds are stacked against you.
A team isn’t a team until it fosters a sense of belonging.
Surrounding yourself with intelligent people is a solid B+ move. But if they’re also down to earth and got your back, it’s a straight A.
You’re done changing buttons. Deep down, you want to change lives.
!

#3 I guess we’re kind of cool
. Folks we’ve got on our team: AI product leaders from Google, engineering talent from Brex, physician executives from major health systems, & more. We’ve got a bunch of doctors who are our friends and have got our backs. We’re growing rapidly with more customer interest than we can onboard, and some of us have fairly special* talents!
#4 Beautiful working space
! Natural light reduces depression and anxiety by a non trivial percent. True story.
!

Push the bleeding-edge in what is technically feasible!
Act like a owner — propose ideas and call your own shots!
Impact hundreds of thousands (hopefully millions) of patient lives!
Win.

Built and scaled your own projects to significant revenue.
Understanding of US healthcare/health-tech.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About Apolink:
Apolink is building the world’s most interoperable satellite relay network in low Earth orbit. Our hybrid communication architecture combines RF and optical inter-satellite links to enable real-time, continuous connectivity for satellite operators across industries.
About The Role:
You will own development of the embedded and flight software stack that powers Apolink’s relay spacecraft platforms. From low-level device drivers to autonomous fault recovery, you’ll design and implement the digital nervous system that makes our satellites reliable and interoperable. You’ll work directly with avionics hardware, vendor SDKs, and payload systems to bring our first mission to orbit in 2026 and lay the foundation for a scalable constellation.
Responsibilities:
Architect and implement real-time flight software for satellite command and control
Develop embedded software for avionics, SDRs, and optical/RF payload subsystems
Build hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, and telemetry/telecommand interfaces
Read and integrate vendor SDKs into the flight stack for bus and payload components
Implement autonomy features, including fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR)
Build and maintain software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) frameworks
Design spacecraft-to-ground communication protocols with authentication and security
Support hardware integration, functional testing, and on-orbit commissioning
Collaborate with RF, GNC, and systems engineers for seamless spacecraft ops
Qualifications:
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
5+ years of experience in embedded/flight software development (space, aerospace, or robotics)
Proficiency in C/C++ for real-time and resource-constrained systems
Experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, VxWorks, RTEMS, or similar)
Strong debugging skills with CI/CD, automated testing, and hardware bring-up
Hands-on experience with embedded communication protocols (CAN, UART, I²C, SPI, RS-422, etc.)
Familiarity with spacecraft operations, comm protocols, and avionics integration
Comfortable working with vendor SDKs and adapting them to flight software needs
Passion for building reliable systems that operate in extreme environments
Ability to work in-person or willingness to relocate to Palo Alto, CA
Compensation and Benefits
Compensation at Apolink is determined based on role, level, location, and alignment with market benchmarks. Individual base salary is assessed on a case-by-case basis, reflecting job-related experience, technical expertise, and overall fit. In addition to salary, Apolink offers long-term incentives such as stock options and discretionary performance bonuses. Benefits include equity participation, comprehensive health care, 401(k) with company matching, flexible vacation, catered meal credits, and ongoing opportunities for professional development.
Additional Information
To conform to the U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Apolink Communications is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
AboutApolink
Apolink is building the world’s most interoperable satellite relay network in low Earth orbit. Our hybrid communication architecture combines RF and optical inter-satellite links to enable real-time, continuous connectivity for satellite operators across industries.

growth. The way we launch, the way people hear about us, the way we cut through the noise — that’s all in your hands.

get
culture. You know when a format’s about to hit before everyone else does. You’d rather launch ten half-crazy tests than polish one “safe” campaign. And you don’t just want to run growth — you want to own it and leave your fingerprints all over this launch.

We don’t care about polished resumes. Just send us three things:
Your boldest growth win (with numbers).
One crazy idea you’d try here on day one.
Links to any accounts or campaigns you’ve run.

Deterministic Web Simulation → Stable, reproducible testing with versioned web snapshots.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
About the role
The FutureClinic Mission
Healthcare is a broken system. It’s the most important thing in anyone’s life, but the ability to both deliver and receive healthcare has been artificially constrained in a brick and mortar system of hospitals and clinics that charge predatory prices, increase administrative bloat, and create barriers between doctors and patients.
This has left doctors disgruntled, with 40% of doctors in the U.S. planning to leave their jobs in the next 5 years. It’s also left patients lost — rationing when they seek care and sacrificing their overall health.
With FutureClinic, we’re building a completely new category of care. Chat-based healthcare. Asynchronous by design, available from anywhere, and mediated by AI assistants who handle data gathering to make the system infinitely more scalable than current healthcare delivery.
We want to make expert, personalized healthcare accessible to 8 billion people in the world. The FutureClinic platform empowers individual doctors to launch their own chat-based clinic and offer direct subscription based care to patients. With this model, we can change the way healthcare is delivered for good. In 5 years, everyone will start their healthcare journey with any new symptom by speaking directly to the doctors they’ve chosen through the FutureClinic app. They’ll only ever seek in person care when it’s truly necessary, not as a default first option.
Join us in bringing that vision to reality, and work on the most meaningful problem in the world — making access to healthcare ubiquitous.
TLDR:
FutureClinic is a YC‑backed (F24) healthcare‑AI startup that empowers any physician to launch a fully compliant, chat‑based digital clinic in days. Patients subscribe to their chosen doctor for a flat monthly fee and can reach out whenever health questions arise—no scheduling, no waiting rooms.
About Us
Funding:
$5 M seed at a $40 M valuation (January 2025).
Founders:
3 of our 4 co‑founders are
both
board‑certified physicians and software engineers.
Model:
Doctors operate through FutureClinic and keep 85 % of revenue; FutureClinic earns a 15 % platform fee.
Product:
Asynchronous chat intake driven by a clinical‑reasoning AI assistant that syncs seamlessly with our AI‑native EHR, e‑prescribing and billing.
Our Current Stack
TypeScript / Node / Hono
in a PNPM monorepo, sharing types across workspaces
Postgres (Cloud SQL) + Drizzle
GCP
GKE Autopilot, GCS, Cloud SQL
DevOps
Terraform CDKTF, CDK8s, GitHub Actions, Docker
Temporal
drives long-running workflows such as EHR record creation
Observability:
Sentry & GCP Cloud Monitoring
What You’ll Do
Design, secure, and scale the core APIs
so thousands of concurrent doctor-patient chats run with high availability and HIPAA-grade protection.
Evolve our Temporal workflows
for billing, chat routing, and EHR synchronization, keeping them fault-tolerant and observable.
Partner with ML engineers
on low-latency model-inference pipelines and real-time LLM monitoring.
Apply your engineering craft
to tackle real healthcare problems that improve patient and clinician experiences every week.
Ship product-focused backend features
from concept to production, measure impact, and iterate fast.
You Might Be a Fit If You…
Have
5+ years
designing, building, and running production software with Node and TypeScript
Taken at least one product from idea to launch as an early engineer at a startup
Love building things people want, whether at work or in side projects and open-source hacks
Thrive in high-ownership, ambiguity-rich 0→1 settings and are happy to dive into any layer of the stack—from Terraform files to TypeScript APIs to quick UI tweaks.
Nice‑to‑Haves
Experience with LLM inference at scale
Why FutureClinic
Direct impact:
Your code will help doctors care for patients the same week it’s written.
Clinical brain‑trust:
Work daily with physician‑engineers who
use
what you build.
Ownership:
Significant equity in a tight 6‑person Series‑A‑bound team.
Velocity & autonomy:
Clear objectives, minimal meetings, rapid iteration.
About the interview
Round 1:
Interview with the CEO to assess overall mission alignment, culture fit, personal background.
Round 2:
Technical interview with CTO and potentially other members of the technical team.
Round 3:
For in person candidates, coming to our office and spending the day with us.

About the role
What’s Curo?
We’re a 9 person startup on a mission to accelerate electrification. We enable commercial fleets to lease EV chargers, helping them to electrify at a fraction of the cost and time. In tandem, we drive additional revenue to owners of EV charging and parking.
Building charging infrastructure as a fleet is expensive, takes a ton of time and in a lot of cases isn’t possible. Conversely, ensuring a return on investment for EV charging and parking assets is really difficult. To efficiently scale, we need mass visibility, stakeholder management and collaboration → enter Curo.
What's the role?
We're looking for a UI/UX-centric software engineer to own the frontend experience across our mobile and web products. You'll be building workflows used by drivers, fleet managers, and site hosts—all of whom rely on fast, intuitive interfaces to succeed.
You'll:
Ship mission-critical surfaces
: charger discovery maps, session trackers, onboarding flows—built in React / Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript and tuned for real-time interactions.
Design the paved path
: create the component library, animation patterns, and accessibility guardrails every future engineer will rely on.
Prototype ↔ validate fast
: turn concepts into live experiments, collect driver/host feedback the same afternoon, and iterate without waiting for “perfect.”
Raise the performance bar
– monitor PostHog funnels for lag or jank, offline-first caching, and low-connectivity fallbacks (parking garages are your proving ground).
Keep it clear, never confusing
– sit with Ops & BD to turn raw fleet pain points into elegant workflows—and defend simplicity whenever complexity tries to creep in.
Partner deeply with backend & data
: co-design APIs, real-time feeds, and analytics hooks that make feature work feel friction-less for the whole team.
Who are we looking for?
5+ yrs
shipping UI/UX in React / Next.js with Tailwind & TypeScript (mobile-first as default).
Proven
design-system ownership
: from tokens and theming to doc-site, versioning, and adoption metrics.
Startup DNA—early employee or founder—comfortable wearing product, design, and eng hats on the same day.
A track record of
building products people love
Bonus points
for map/geo UI, real-time data (WebSockets, polling, postgres realtime), or prior work in mobility / climate tech.
Core Values
You’re Driven → We bring passion to everything we do.
You Have Good Vibes → We show up authentically for each other, every single day.
You’re Scrappy → We lean into our curiosity to find creative solutions.
You’re Trustworthy → We follow through on our commitments.
You’re Collaborative → We lift each other up and share both victories and challenges.
You’re Fearless → We take smart risks and speak up with conviction.

Curo helps electric fleets to park and charge when their operations are distributed, we do this by building tools for owners of underutilized EV charging sites to simplify sharing their infra with fleets. We're a 6 person startup rapidly scaling our business unit.

When firms analyze deals through Keye, they tap into a deep library of diligence knowledge and best practices, built from over a decade of real investor experience. Our proprietary analysis engine helps teams quickly identify high-potential deals and move faster on the ones that matter.
We’re a team of investors and engineers with backgrounds at Vista Equity Partners, Permira, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, Tesla and multiple startups. Our founding team has over 20 years of M&A investing experience, has founded companies before, and has been part of four successful acquisitions as early employees.
Keye is revenue-generating and has grown 600% in the last six months (
some press about our growth
here
). We’re backed by top-tier investors including Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Sorenson Capital, and Plug and Play.

The Role
We’re hiring a
Founding Strategist – Private Equity
to lead the full lifecycle of client engagement—from initial demo to platform activation and expansion. Your goal is to drive product fit with each of our ICP clients. This is a technical role that requires prior experience as an investor in private equity.
The position is in-person in New York (relocation support available).
You’ll work closely with our CEO, COO, sales, and product teams to lead platform adoption, drive activation, and turn user feedback into meaningful product improvements. You will be the face of Keye to our clients—working with them daily on real data, live deals, and high-stakes diligence.
This is a client-first, product-critical, and founder-level role. You’ll own core relationships, build new processes, and help shape the team from the ground up.
__________________________________________________________________________________________________________
What You’ll Do
Drive customer activation—ensuring firms not only onboard, but fully adopt the platform
Own relationships with clients from demo to rollout, often working directly with them on live deal data
Run tailored POCs that showcase platform value using real, quantitative diligence processes
Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with senior PE professionals—across business and informal settings
Collaborate with product and engineering to prioritize, spec, and ship features that drive usage
Turn PE workflows and client feedback into actionable roadmap decisions
Help define the future structure of the platform strategy org—spanning engagement, success, and support
What We’re Looking For
2–6 years in Private Equity (investing role).
Deep experience with analyses carried out during due diligence (beyond just commercial DD)
Confident presenter with experience engaging senior stakeholders
Entrepreneurial, process-driven, with strong product sense and ability to work across teams
Works with urgency, clarity, and a strong sense of ownership
Socially confident—comfortable leading client sessions, dinners, and events
Based in NYC or open to relocating
Comfortable in high-pressure, fast-paced environments with tight deadlines and demanding clients
Why Now
Lead and define a core function at a breakout AI startup
Work closely with the founding team to shape strategy and product
Build and lead a future team of platform strategists, engagement managers, and sales engineers
Own relationships with top-tier PE firms at the forefront of digital transformation
Be part of a generational shift in how PE firms use technology
You’ll be joining a passionate, high-energy team that’s relentless about building something industry-defining. If you’re looking to leave investing and actually build—this is your role
AboutKeye
Keye is an incoming Y-Combinator (YC F24) and venture-backed startup focused on speeding up the due diligence process in private market mergers and acquisitions with AI.
Our platform analyzes data rooms in dealmaking using advanced data and machine learning techniques and gives investors 80% of the deal in under 30 minutes, a process that otherwise takes weeks! The output is an interactive diligence report to help funds say no to a deal much earlier and save millions on third-party diligence costs.
When firms use Keye to analyze deals, they’re tapping into a wealth of diligence knowledge and best practices that are baked into our proprietary analysis engine from over a decade of investor experience. Keye is generating revenue and has grown 600% in the past 6 months. We also have a long waitlist for early access users, and we're planning to release our beta to them in October. You’ll play a key role on the team, helping launch and ship features daily for users to test and provide feedback on.

Leverage AWS for deployment, along with Redis and Celery for efficient queuing and background task management, ensuring our operations run smoothly at scale.

Collaborate on integrating advanced AI models (like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Deep Seek) that drive the exceptional accuracy of our testing simulations.

Strong experience with Django & NextJS and a passion for writing clean, modular, and efficient Python/next code.
Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment.
Familiarity with cloud deployment (preferably AWS) and asynchronous task processing using tools like Redis and Celery.
A proactive mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail.
An eagerness to stay updated with the latest in web development and AI technologies.

About the role
About Symphony
Symphony is building voice AI sims for large enterprises.
Use cases include training front-line employees and augmenting & automating customer-facing workflows.
Since launching in January, we’re live with 4 of the top 10 auto insurers in North America, helping train 1000s of newly hired claims adjusters using interactive voice AI simulations of real-world scenarios. Teams can create an infinite number of simulations allowing their teams to practice the job - avoiding costly mistakes with real customers.
We graduated from YCombinator’s F24 batch and are backed by top investors in Silicon Valley including 22 Ventures, Transpose Platform, and Rebel Fund.
What you’ll do
Take full ownership of new product features — from scoping and user experience design to implementation across the frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers
Refine and test prompts and build new agentic features, researching novel approaches to improve reliability of LLM-based functionality
Collaborate with founders to scope, plan, and prioritize new features
Lead engineering best practices and code quality standards, leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate development and maintain technical excellence
Work directly with enterprise customers—from sales and onboarding to implementation and ongoing support—to ensure successful adoption and feedback-driven iteration
You’ll enjoy this role if you:
Are excited to experiment with new features as LLMs unlock product experiences that require rethinking traditional UI and workflows
Enjoy thinking through new features end to end, including scalability, extensible abstractions, data model design, and long-term reliability
Want extreme autonomy and ownership, including leading mission-critical initiatives from idea to execution
Are ready to have a front-row seat at a high-growth startup, helping us craft our long-term vision, contributing to our GTM efforts, and pushing our hiring efforts
What a typical week might look like
Use the latest AI coding tools to ship a critical feature end-to end
Review user session recordings and feedback to find ways to improve our no-code role play builder
Research and test advancements in the voice AI world, including new LLM and speech-to-text capabilities that can make AI roleplays more dynamic and human-like
Build a custom prototype of a new feature to help push a sale
Propose roadmap changes to the founders
What we’re looking for
3+ years of software engineering experience, owning end-to-end development efforts and leading technical decisions
Experience across the stack, including frontend frameworks like React/Next.js, backend technologies like Node.js or Flask, relational databases, and/or infrastructure management
High ownership - you’re not afraid to take accountability for large bodies of mission-critical work
Strong verbal and written communication skills that enable crystal-clear, unambiguous collaboration with customers, teammates, and during technical discussions
Opinionated about code quality and architectural decisions, with a bias toward maintainability, clarity, and long-term scalability
Able to operate with minimal direction—proactively asking questions, doing your own research, and engaging others to resolve ambiguity
Bonus points
Prior experience founding a software startup
Built tools leveraging LLMs or ML in production
Experience with real-time applications and technologies such as WebRTC, WebSockets, or streaming media pipelines
Experience working on enterprise Saas applications
About the interview
30-minute intro chat
You’ll chat with one of the founders to quickly get a sense of mutual fit and whether it makes sense to move forward.
45-minute technical interview
A deeper conversation covering your past work, technical skills, and how you approach problems.
Paid work trial (5-7 days)
You’ll join us for about a week and work on a real project. We’ll compensate you hourly. This is a chance for us to see how you work, and for you to get a feel for what it’s like to be part of the team.
The project
You’ll take on a well-scoped but ambiguous problem — the kind of work you’d be doing day-to-day. This won’t be throwaway work; it’ll be a real feature or improvement we plan to ship.
Timing
Ideally, you’re able to work full-time in-person for the trial week. But we understand that may not always be feasible — if needed, nights and weekends are fine, and we’ll work with your schedule to make sure we have enough overlap to collaborate.
Decision
We aim to make a final decision within 1 day of completing the work trial.

.

entire codebase is your playground
, and your mission is to solve customer problems—wherever they live. Whether it’s backend, UI, AI logic, or even writing documentation or emails, you do what it takes to get things done.

About the role
Diode Computers, Inc. is looking for a senior software engineer to help us fix circuit board design and manufacturing.
The team has shipped real hardware at Apple, Anduril, and several med-tech startups; now we’re focusing our attention on helping others build hardware better. We’ve raised $14M and were featured on the a16z
“American Dynamism 50”
list this year. Our customers include some of the biggest names in robotics, health-tech, and defense.
Since we make software for hardware, you'll learn lots about the world of building physical things, even if you haven't tinkered with electronics before. You'll quickly pick up the basics of electrical engineering and PCB design, and we expect you to bring a strong software-first lens as we build tools for our customers and in-house EE team.
We work in a fast, engineering-driven culture. We iterate on ideas quickly, and expect you to take ownership over what you build. You'll make decisions on everything from technical implementation to UX, and drive projects through from idea to production.
What you'll do
We move fast, so expect each week to look a little different than the last. That said, here’s a sampling of projects we have/will work on, to give you a taste for the kinds of problems we think about.
Designing a programming language for PCB schematics that is intuitive for both humans and LLMs to read and write
Rust compiler and CLI build tool for compiling schematics and interacting with the rest of our infrastructure
API integrations with PCB fabs for real-time quoting and ordering
Constraint-based layout algorithm for automatically arranging components on a PCB
Auto-generated electrical schematics visualization
AI agents to automate various steps of the design process, building on our bespoke tooling
Collaborate with our in-house EE team to ruthlessly optimize their workflow
Contribute to
open source
libraries, and publish our own (more here soon)
We work mostly in Rust and Python with some TypeScript for frontend apps.
What you'll need
A few years of experience with at least one of {Rust, Python, TypeScript}
Some prior experience owning large parts of a technical project
Excitement to work hard on hard technical problems
The ability to work from our office in NYC, ~5 days a week
Bonus points:
You've tinkered with hardware before (even small hobby projects). If not, you’ll learn on the job!
Experience with building robust AI tools (agents, evals, the whole shebang)
What you'll get
A competitive salary and equity grant
Free food and the occasional team offsite
Great healthcare (incl. vision, dental), PTO, and other benefits
Relocation support to NYC, if you need it
About the interview
30 min chat with founder(s): We’ll tell you more about our company and backgrounds, and you’ll tell us a bit about what you’re looking for.
1-2 technical interviews with team: We want to see how you approach problems. You’ll get an open-ended technical problem and we’ll work together to implement a solution. You’ll screen share and use whatever tools or codegen you want: the idea is to simulate how we work together in practice.
3-5 day paid work trial in NYC: You’ll spend a few days with us in NYC and we’ll pay you for your time. We want you to get to know our working styles, and to get to know yours. (We can be flexible and work around your schedule here.)
References + offer: We’ll ask for a couple references and then give you an offer. If you’re moving to NYC, we’ll cover your expenses and help you find a place, if you need it.
AboutDiode Computers, Inc.
Diode works with hardware companies to design and manufacture circuit boards (PCBs) to their specifications. We do this in days instead of months.

absolute best FTL carrier brokers and FTL relationship managers
— people who’ve spent time at brokerages, 3PLs or company departments that source and develop carrier relationships — to help us scale our national carrier base and lock in recurring lanes. If you live and breathe freight and love building relationships with owner-operators and fleets, we want to talk.
What You'll Do
Source and onboard qualified FTL and partial carriers into Oway’s network using our in-house software tools — especially for high-volume lanes like CA → TX, CA → FL, CA → WA, CA → IL, backhauls and more.
Manage relationships with fleets ranging from 30 to 1000+ vehicles.
Help expand our
dynamic freight pool
by matching carriers with algorithmically optimized loads and bundling opportunities, and make partial freight more accessible for carriers.
Educate carriers on our
app-based onboarding
,
automated load offering, digital BOL/POD
, and
automated payments
systems.
Act as a partner to operations, sales, and product as we refine our nationwide carrier network.

3+ years
at a freight brokerage or 3PL in a carrier-facing role (e.g. Carrier Sales Rep, Capacity Rep, Truckload Procurement)
Have experience with a clear funnel of onboarding carriers and intuitively working around individual humps and roadblocks without needing heavy guidance.
Deep understanding of FTL/partial load dynamics, especially working with med-sized fleets (not owner operators).
Strong negotiation and communication skills; able to keep carriers loyal with recurring freight.

quick pay, factoring
, and incentive strategies.

ELD integrations
,
load boards
, or
routing platforms.

AboutOway
Oway is popularizing a completely new way to affordably ship up to 12 pallets across long distances by creating the largest live network of empty truck space.. It's a huge problem - almost half of all truck space goes unused every year in the now trillion-dollar US trucking industry.
We are constantly looking for the brightest up-and-coming problem solvers for our team to help tackle one of the country's largest problems. Oway is an extremely collaborative environment, and our goal is to make solving this problem fun while also performing at our best.

About the role
About the Role
Elayne is an
Applied AI company reimagining how families organize, protect, and transfer their estates
, from financial accounts and legal documents to digital assets and end-of-life wishes.
We combine structured data, custom AI agents, and guided UX
to make estate optimization and post-loss settlement fast, clear, and dignified.
We integrate with banks, insurance providers, legal systems, and data aggregators to create a real-time, intelligent view of an individual or family’s estate
. Then we proactively adapt to life events (like having a child or losing a parent), and automate complex legal-financial workflows that typically take families years to finish.
We’re an Accel and YC-backed seed stage company
, launched last year and we’re operating in a manual
$260B TAM
, with over $80T in assets expected to transfer in the coming decades. This is a greenfield market for AI, and we intend to define the category.
Your Mission:
As the
Founding Senior Engineer (AI/ML)
, you’ll build production-grade AI systems that are technically rigorous, reliable, and scalable.
Working closely with the founding team, you’ll
design and implement LLM-based features using RAG, vector search, and multi-step agent workflows
to address challenges like entity resolution, document classification, and contextual memory management.
You’ll play a key role in developing core infrastructure for prompt orchestration, embedding pipelines, and real-time inference, while optimizing for latency, cost, trust, and personalized outcomes.
Your work will shape how millions of families navigate one of life’s most difficult transitions: losing a loved one
. In this senior role, you’ll have the autonomy to move quickly, prototype novel architectures, and translate complex ML systems into intuitive, deeply human experiences.
What We’re Looking For:
Builder’s mindset
: you move fast, take full ownership, write reliable systems, and are obsessed with solving real problems
4+ years of engineering experience
shipping production-grade AI features or infrastructure
Strong Python and AI/ML background,
with experience building agentic or RAG-based systems using LangChain, vector DBs, and evaluation frameworks
Skilled in building scalable full-stack solutions
using TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS and modern data tools
Thrive in ambiguity, urgency, and rapid iteration
- ideally you’ve been part of a high intensity seed stage startup before (we work long hours, but have a lot of fun together)
Based in NYC and excited to work in-person
at our NoMad HQ
What You’ll Do:
Design and build AI-native product features
like document parsing, task checklists, and smart suggestions
Integrate models (OpenAI, Anthropic, OSS) into workflows
using LangChain, custom pipelines, or purpose-built flows
Collaborate with the founding team on
technical scoping, architecture, and infrastructure decisions
Contribute to embedding strategies
, feedback loops, and prompt tuning frameworks
Define and implement evaluation frameworks
to measure output quality, user trust, latency, and model performance
Stay on the frontier of AI tooling and infrastructure and
bring practical innovations into production
Current stack:
React, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, OpenAI, Auth0. You don’t need to know everything, but we value engineers who learn fast and aren’t afraid to jump in
Upcoming challenges include
building memory across sessions, reliable summarization pipelines, and intelligent fallback mechanisms for partially structured data.
We’ll be a great fit if you’re looking for:
A rare
chance to build an iconic company with actual human impact
; not just another AI CRM or dev tool
An opportunity to
grow into a technical leader
, mentor others, and set the technical and ethical foundations for how AI guides financial and legal decisions
YC, Accel, and mission-aligned investors backing a product with
massive, untapped demand
Compensation:
Salary range $160k–$250k,
depending on experience and qualifications
Meaningful equity package is included;
final composition will be determined by level, scope, relevant experience, and cash vs equity preference. Benefits/PTO included.
Additional detail
AboutElayne
Elayne helps families organize their assets, estate documents, and key contacts in one place, then guides them through life transitions as circumstances and priorities evolve. Like getting married, moving, having a baby, or losing a parent.
Unlike traditional wealth management tools or online estate platforms that produce static legal documents, Elayne is dynamic, intelligent, and built not just to delight, but to comfort and guide you when it matters most.
I started Elayne after my mom passed away and I had to settle her estate, accounts, and affairs - essentially, I suddenly had to untangle all the details of her life. It was shocking how fragmented and opaque the process was and how I spent hundreds of hours chasing documents, coordinating accounts, filling legal gaps, and navigating unfamiliar systems, all while grieving and working full time. It shouldn’t be that way.
In the future, you could hire an attorney, download DIY legal forms, fax and mail physical documents, sync 10 different fintech apps, use a financial planner, spend thousands in fees, and hope it all holds together. Or, you could just use Elayne.
Backed by major investors like Y Combinator and Accel, we are now a 6 person team based in NYC.

Elayne helps families organize their assets, estate documents, and key contacts in one place, then guides them through life transitions as circumstances and priorities evolve. Like getting married, moving, having a baby, or losing a parent.
Unlike traditional wealth management tools or online estate platforms that produce static legal documents, Elayne is dynamic, intelligent, and built not just to delight, but to comfort and guide you when it matters most.
I started Elayne after my mom passed away and I had to settle her estate, accounts, and affairs - essentially, I suddenly had to untangle all the details of her life. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
About Cartage
Cartage is building Wilson, an AI that orchestrates shipments for manufacturers and distributors. Our customers range from lumber mills to furniture manufacturers. If you’re looking to make a difference in an industry that’s ripe for change, Cartage is the place for you. Our culture is built on high ownership and autonomy – we trust each team member to take initiative and drive projects forward. We also value collaboration and transparency at all levels, empowering everyone to do the most meaningful work of their careers as we build the future of logistics.
About the Role
As a Sales Development Representative, you will be at the forefront of Cartage’s growth, acting as the first point of contact for prospective customers and the driving force behind our sales pipeline. In this role, you’ll combine persistence, creativity, and communication skills to turn cold prospects into valuable clients. No two days will be the same – one day you might be cold calling a list of prospects, and the next you could be crafting a thought-leadership post on LinkedIn to engage new leads. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy position, perfect for a self-starter who loves challenges and wants to grow their career in tech sales.
Location:
San Francisco, CA. This role offers flexibility for remote or hybrid work arrangements based out of our San Francisco office.
Key Responsibilities
- Prospect and generate leads: Proactively identify and create new sales opportunities through high-volume cold calling and other outbound outreach methods.
- Book meetings and drive pipeline: Consistently book at least 10+ meetings per month with qualified prospects by effectively pitching Cartage’s value proposition and following up on leads.
- Multi-channel outreach: Leverage an omni-channel approach – phone calls, emails, video conferencing, and social media – to engage and nurture prospective clients.
- Content engagement: Create and share engaging content (e.g. LinkedIn posts) to build awareness, demonstrate thought leadership, and attract potential customers to Cartage.
- Qualify and hand off leads: Qualify inbound and outbound leads to determine fit, and set up meetings or product demos between prospective customers and the Account Executive team.
- Collaborate with the team: Work closely with sales and leadership on targeting strategies and ensure a smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.
- Manage data & follow-up: Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and activities in our CRM system, and regularly follow up with leads to drive engagement.
- Own your goals: Take ownership of your pipeline and consistently meet or exceed your monthly targets for meetings booked and opportunities created. Continuously refine your approach based on feedback and coaching.
Qualifications
- Experience: 1–2 years in a sales, business development, or other customer-facing role (SDR/BDR experience is a plus).
- Communication skills: Excellent communication skills via phone, email, and social media, with the ability to engage prospects and clearly articulate value propositions.
- Cold-calling prowess: Comfortable making cold calls and reaching out to new prospects daily, turning cold introductions into warm opportunities.
- Track record of success: Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets or activity quotas, and a strong motivation driven by results.
- Drive and resilience: High-energy, results-driven attitude with a desire to succeed in a fast-paced, startup environment. Able to handle rejection and persist with a positive mindset.
- Ownership & autonomy: Solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership over your work – you take “extreme ownership” of your goals and thrive in an environment with high autonomy.
- Team player: Collaborative and coachable, eager to learn from others and share knowledge. Values transparency and open communication within the team.
- Tech savvy: Familiarity with CRM software and sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is a plus.
- Industry knowledge: Logistics, freight, or supply chain industry experience is nice to have but not required – we’ll teach you what you need to know.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
Why Join Cartage?
You’ll be joining a sales team with a great culture and a focus on growth and development, making this a fun and dynamic place to work. We invest in our people through training, mentorship, and clear career paths. In fact, we view our SDRs as the talent engine that fuels our sales organization’s success, and we give you the tools and opportunities to take your skills to the next level. This role will put you on the front lines of transforming a multi-trillion-dollar industry, allowing you to have a direct impact on how goods move around the world.
We also believe in enjoying the journey. We foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where everyone’s ideas are heard and valued. We celebrate our wins together and learn from our losses as a team. If you’re solution-oriented, love taking on challenges, and want to be part of a forward-thinking team that’s revolutionizing logistics, Cartage is the place for you.
AboutCartage

About the role
Pax is building the AI-powered financial infrastructure that turns lost tariffs into profits
Every year, U.S. companies overpay more than
$10 billion
in tariffs they’re legally entitled to recover - and
95% of them never claim a cent
. That’s hundreds of millions of dollars just
left on the table
by retailers, manufacturers, and logistics providers because the refund process is archaic, opaque, and manual.
Pax is building the AI-powered duty-drawback platform that changes that.
We ingest import/export, customs, and ERP data to automatically identify refund eligibility, file claims, and recover cash - often
7 and 8-figure sums per company
with
zero
friction. Think of us as “
Stripe for tariff refunds
”: an intelligent financial infrastructure layer that makes something once painful, slow, and complicated feel like a single API call.
💡 Why Now
Tariffs have exploded
: with many companies seeing rates rise from
25% to 145%
since 2018, yet the refund infrastructure hasn’t evolved in decades.
Global trade is massive and growing
: $5 trillion in U.S. imports annually, with ~$200 billion of that eligible for drawback.
Policy tailwinds:
Recent trade policy shifts and supply-chain realignment are increasing both the scale and urgency of reclaiming tariffs.

jobs.title: Quantum Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
About the role
Conductor Quantum is building quantum computers on silicon chips. Our software automates the calibration and tune-up of semiconductor qubits—turning raw hardware into a ready-to-run platform. By eliminating the biggest bottleneck in quantum computing (manual device configuration), we’re enabling thousands (and eventually billions) of qubits to operate reliably at scale.
This is your opportunity to do the best work of your life, shaping the future of computing as part of a small, passionate team of quantum physicists, hardware engineers, and machine learning experts.
We are looking for high intelligence, high energy, and high integrity individuals who are hungry to change the world.
Role Overview: Quantum Engineer
As a Quantum Engineer, you will directly shape Conductor Quantum’s core offerings—software systems that analyze device data in real-time, optimize qubit parameters, and seamlessly integrate with both on-premise and cloud infrastructures. You will architect, build, and maintain the next-generation control and calibration stack while collaborating closely with customers, physicists, and hardware engineers. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role, where you will define best practices, influence product strategy, and help lay the foundation for Conductor Quantum’s culture and growth.
Key Responsibilities
Quantum Device Fabrication & Bring-Up:
Take quantum dot devices from the lab bench to operational readiness. Perform wire bonding, device packaging, and chip mounting for cryogenic testing. Design and fabricate custom PCBs for signal routing, filtering, and integration with control electronics.
Experimental Setup & Measurement Infrastructure:
Build and maintain cryogenic measurement setups, including dilution refrigerators, fridge wiring, and line testing. Specify, install, and test hardware components such as low-noise amplifiers, DC lines, filters, bias tees, and microwave components. Develop robust procedures for cooldowns, thermal cycling, and system diagnostics.
Device Tuning & Characterization:
Run transport, rf-reflectometry and charge sensing measurements to identify quantum dot and spin qubit formation, tune gate voltages, and extract stability diagrams. Optimize device configurations through iterative tuning, and collaborate with software and machine learning teams to close the loop on automated calibration routines.
Lab Development & Instrument Control:
Lead the setup and scaling of the experimental lab environment. Define lab requirements, spec out measurement equipment, and manage lab logistics. Write or adapt control software to interface with waveform generators, DACs, and lock-in amplifiers.
Collaboration & System Integration:
Work closely with physicists, ML engineers, and backend developers to integrate hardware, software, and data pipelines into a unified quantum control stack. Provide feedback on usability, stability, and performance from a hardware and systems perspective.
Other Perks
Free healthcare, dental and vision.
About the interview
1 hour chat.
System design interview.
Physics and Maths interview.
Behavioral interview.
Paid in-person trial week.
AboutConductor Quantum
We are an American company headquartered in San Francisco, California. We are assembling a highly leveraged team of cracked engineers whose sole focus is to develop software to enable fault-tolerant quantum computation.
If you would like to expand the quantum frontier and solve one of the hardest technological challenges of our time, this is your chance.
